# file opened: zpolice.asm
   1  0000              ;==============================================================================
   2  0000              ; Z-POLICE  -  3D vector city flight for the ZX Spectrum Next
   3  0000              ;
   4  0000              ;  Z80N assembler (sjasmplus --zxnext).  Layer 2 256x192x8bpp, double buffered.
   5  0000              ;  The 3D viewport is the top 256x128; the bottom third is an instrument panel.
   6  0000              ;  Maths: world positions are 16-bit integers (one city cell = 256 units),
   7  0000              ;         trig values are S7.8 fixed point (1.0 = $0100).
   8  0000              ;  Hidden line removal: painter's algorithm. Buildings are walked over the
   9  0000              ;  grid far-to-near (no sort needed). Each visible face is filled in its
  10  0000              ;  shade (roof lighter, side turned away darker) and optionally outlined, so
  11  0000              ;  nearer buildings overwrite those behind them. Faces with every corner on
  12  0000              ;  screen use cached projections; faces crossing the view frustum are
  13  0000              ;  clipped in 3D (Sutherland-Hodgman, 5 planes). Rasterisation then only
  14  0000              ;  ever sees on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
  15  0000              ;
  16  0000              ;  Controls: Q/A speed up/down   Z air brake O/P turn left/right
  17  0000              ;            W/S climb/descend   E/D nose up/down
  18  0000              ;            SPACE fire          1-5 select weapon slot
  19  0000              ;            0 change the centre slot's weapon
  20  0000              ;
  21  0000              ;  Source files: zpolice.asm (resident main code), memory_bank_defs.asm
  22  0000              ;  (slots and pages).  Game logic pages, swapped into slot 6 at $C000:
  23  0000              ;  player.asm (input/movement), weapons.asm, menu.asm (main menu).  Core
  24  0000              ;  function pages, swapped into slot 7 at $E000: city.asm (Layer 2
  25  0000              ;  drawing), hud.asm (ULA HUD), input.asm (redefinable keys, joysticks), sprites.asm
  26  0000              ;  (hardware sprites).  Always mapped: zombie.asm at $2000, human.asm and
  27  0000              ;  map.asm (the city map) at $7000.
  28  0000              ;
  29  0000              ;  Memory while running:
  30  0000              ;    $0000-$1FFF  Layer 2 back buffer, one 8K section at a time (slot 0)
  31  0000              ;    $2000-$3FFF  zombie page (slot 1)
  32  0000              ;    $4000-$7FFF  occlusion data; cell colours, humans, map (slots 2-3)
  33  0000              ;    $8000-$9FFF  ULA screen (slot 4)
  34  0000              ;    $A000-$BFFF  resident code, tables, variables, stack (slot 5)
  35  0000              ;    $C000-$DFFF  game logic page (slot 6)
  36  0000              ;    $E000-$FFFF  core function page (slot 7)
  37  0000              ;==============================================================================
  38  0000
  39  0000                      DEVICE ZXSPECTRUMNEXT
  40  0000                      SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM, LOGPOINT, ASSERTION
  41  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
  42  0000 ~                    CSPECTMAP "release_tmp/zpolice.map"
  43  0000                  ELSE
  44  0000                      CSPECTMAP zpolice.map
  45  0000                  ENDIF
  46  0000                      OPT --zxnext=cspect --syntax=a --reversepop
  47  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48  0000              ; Build options
  49  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  50  0000              ; RELEASE: the build for players (-DRELEASE: build.bat release).  Turns off
  51  0000              ; everything for testing, whatever is set below: the DEBUG_ settings, DRAW_FPS
  52  0000              ; and DOTS_ALL, a START_LEVEL_SET, a START_SALVAGE.  It's assembled into
  53  0000              ; release_tmp/, so the debug build's files (and the tests') stay as they are.
  54  0000
  55  0000              ; REAL_HARDWARE: the build for a real Next (-DREAL_HARDWARE: build.bat
  56  0000              ; hardware), which may use DMA+ (the zxnDDMA, the blitter of core 3.03.00, see
  57  0000              ; layer2_cls.asm).  Off, the DMA routines use only the plain zxnDMA, as CSpect
  58  0000              ; doesn't have DMA+ yet.  The .nex then also asks for core 3.03.00: on an older
  59  0000              ; core DMA+'s commands would be misread, not ignored.
  60  0000                      ;DEFINE REAL_HARDWARE
  61  0000
  62  0000              ; DRAW_LINES: outline building faces with EDGE_COL vectors.  Comment it out for solid-colour buildings only; the HUD
  63  0000              ; is always drawn.  Can also be set from the command line: -DDRAW_LINES
  64  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_LINES
  65  0000
  66  0000              ; WAIT_FOR_VBLANK: wait for the raster to leave the display area before
  67  0000              ; flipping the Layer 2 buffers (no tearing).  Comment it out to flip as soon
  68  0000              ; as a frame is drawn: faster, but the flip may tear mid-screen.
  69  0000              ; Command line: -DWAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  70  0000                      ;DEFINE WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  71  0000
  72  0000              ; DRAW_FPS: measure frames per second from the raster (vtick) and show it at
  73  0000              ; the top left of the ULA screen.  Comment it out to drop the measuring and
  74  0000              ; the display.  Command line: -DDRAW_FPS
  75  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_FPS
  76  0000
  77  0000              ; SKY_IS_WALL: the camera can never rise above the perimeter wall, so fill
  78  0000              ; the sky in the wall's colour and draw wall cells only up to camera height
  79  0000              ; (their top edge is then exactly the horizon).  No sky is ever seen.
  80  0000              ; Command line: -DSKY_IS_WALL
  81  0000                      DEFINE SKY_IS_WALL
  82  0000
  83  0000              ; OCCLUSION_CULL: in level flight, record the buildings, then cull those
  84  0000              ; completely hidden behind nearer ones (a per-column cover buffer, front to
  85  0000              ; back) before drawing the rest.  Uses pages PAGE_OCC0/1 at $4000-$7FFF.
  86  0000              ; Command line: -DOCCLUSION_CULL
  87  0000                      DEFINE OCCLUSION_CULL
  88  0000
  89  0000              ; OCC_PITCHED: OCCLUSION_CULL pitched too, up to OCC_PMAX (18, city2.asm;
  90  0000              ; past it the plain way).  Pitched, occ_pretest has bounds of its own
  91  0000              ; (occ_pretest.pit), and a building covers only the columns of both its top
  92  0000              ; and bottom corners (its vertical edges lean).  Pixel-identical (124 random
  93  0000              ; pitched views; test_render.py checks 16 against the painter's path).
  94  0000              ; Comment it out for level flight only.  Command line: -DOCC_PITCHED
  95  0000                      DEFINE OCC_PITCHED
  96  0000
  97  0000              ; LEVEL_FAST_PATH: while pitch is 0 (level flight) a building's top corners
  98  0000              ; have the same camera X and Z as the bottom corners below them, so each top
  99  0000              ; corner reuses its bottom corner's screen x and 1/Z and only works out its
 100  0000              ; screen y.  Comment it out to project every corner in full.
 101  0000              ; Command line: -DLEVEL_FAST_PATH
 102  0000                      DEFINE LEVEL_FAST_PATH
 103  0000
 104  0000              ; CLIP_2D: a face that crosses only the screen's sides, top or bottom, and is
 105  0000              ; within a guard band (|X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z), has its corners projected to
 106  0000              ; 16-bit screen coordinates and is clipped against the screen in 2D, not in
 107  0000              ; 3D (no new points to project, one multiply per new point, not three).
 108  0000              ; Faces crossing the near plane, or outside the guard band, are clipped in
 109  0000              ; 3D as before.  Comment it out to clip every face in 3D.
 110  0000              ; Command line: -DCLIP_2D
 111  0000                      DEFINE CLIP_2D
 112  0000
 113  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
 114  0000 ~                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 115  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DRAW_FPS
 116  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 117  0000 ~                  IFDEF DOTS_ALL
 118  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DOTS_ALL
 119  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 120  0000 ~                  IFDEF START_LEVEL_SET
 121  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE START_LEVEL_SET
 122  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 123  0000                  ENDIF

# file opened: memory_bank_defs.asm
   1+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 0000              ; Z-POLICE - memory bank definitions
   3+ 0000              ;
   4+ 0000              ; The Next maps its RAM into the Z80's 64K as eight 8K MMU slots, each set by
   5+ 0000              ; a NextReg ($50-$57) to an 8K page (page n = half of 16K bank n/2).  This
   6+ 0000              ; file names the slots, their registers and addresses, what each slot is
   7+ 0000              ; used for, and which page holds what.  Use:
   8+ 0000              ;   nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY            ; page the city code in at $E000
   9+ 0000              ;   MMU CODE_SLOT e, PAGE_CITY, CODE_ADDR ; (sjasmplus) assemble into it
  10+ 0000              ;
  11+ 0000              ; Memory map (see README.md):
  12+ 0000              ;   slot 0 $0000  Layer 2 sections (32 rows each) while drawing; the sine
  13+ 0000              ;                 table (PAGE_SIN) whenever get_sin reads it
  14+ 0000              ;   slot 1 $2000  zombie page, always mapped: zombies, humans, the HUD
  15+ 0000              ;                 map, the IM 2 table
  16+ 0000              ;   slot 2 $4000  occlusion data; the 320x256 graphics (PAGE_L320) on the
  17+ 0000              ;                 screens outside the game
  18+ 0000              ;   slot 3 $6000  the city bank (always mapped): city_col at $6000,
  19+ 0000              ;                 city_map at $7000, loaded from the level's city file
  20+ 0000              ;   slot 4 $8000  ULA screen (page 10, the first half of bank 5)
  21+ 0000              ;   slot 5 $A000  resident main code, variables, stack (page 11, the unused
  22+ 0000              ;                 second half of bank 5)
  23+ 0000              ;   slot 6 $C000  game logic pages, swapped: player, weapons, menus, level
  24+ 0000              ;                 loading
  25+ 0000              ;   slot 7 $E000  core function pages, swapped: city (Layer 2 drawing), HUD,
  26+ 0000              ;                 keys, sprites; a sprite bank while it is loaded; the
  27+ 0000              ;                 start-up set-up (initialise.asm) once
  28+ 0000              ; So game logic in slot 6 can call any core page in slot 7: main_loop pages
  29+ 0000              ; the keys in at $E000 while the player and weapons pages run at $C000.
  30+ 0000              ; At start-up the NEX loader's default mapping is in place (slot 6 = page
  31+ 0000              ; 0), so the entry point is a stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000 (boot, zpolice.asm)
  32+ 0000              ; that maps the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
  33+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
  34+ 0000
  35+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  36+ 0000              ; MMU slots: number, NextReg, address
  37+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  38+ 0000              MEMBANK_SIZE            equ $2000       ; 8K a slot / page
  39+ 0000
  40+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0              equ 0
  41+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1              equ 1
  42+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2              equ 2
  43+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3              equ 3
  44+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4              equ 4
  45+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5              equ 5
  46+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6              equ 6
  47+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7              equ 7
  48+ 0000
  49+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER     equ $50
  50+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER     equ $51
  51+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER     equ $52
  52+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER     equ $53
  53+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER     equ $54
  54+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER     equ $55
  55+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER     equ $56
  56+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER     equ $57
  57+ 0000
  58+ 0000              membank0                equ $0000
  59+ 0000              membank1                equ $2000
  60+ 0000              membank2                equ $4000
  61+ 0000              membank3                equ $6000
  62+ 0000              membank4                equ $8000
  63+ 0000              membank5                equ $A000
  64+ 0000              membank6                equ $C000
  65+ 0000              membank7                equ $E000
  66+ 0000
  67+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  68+ 0000              ; What each slot is used for: <use>_SLOT, <use>_MMU (its NextReg) and
  69+ 0000              ; <use>_ADDR (the ORG of code or data assembled for it)
  70+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  71+ 0000              ; slot 0: one 32-row section of a Layer 2 buffer at a time (seg_map etc.)
  72+ 0000              L2SEC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_0
  73+ 0000              L2SEC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  74+ 0000              L2SEC_ADDR              equ membank0
  75+ 0000              ; slot 0 also: the sine table, paged in by get_sin (resident).  Only the
  76+ 0000              ; game logic calls it, never the drawing, and every Layer 2 writer maps its
  77+ 0000              ; own section first, so the two never meet.  Nothing may write to
  78+ 0000              ; $0000-$1FFF while it is mapped.
  79+ 0000              SIN_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_0
  80+ 0000              SIN_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  81+ 0000              SIN_ADDR                equ membank0
  82+ 0000
  83+ 0000              ; slot 1: zombie.asm, human.asm, map.asm, interrupts.asm, always mapped
  84+ 0000              ZOMBIE_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_1
  85+ 0000              ZOMBIE_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER
  86+ 0000              ZOMBIE_ADDR             equ membank1
  87+ 0000
  88+ 0000              ; slot 2: occlusion buffer, draw list and building records (OCCLUSION_CULL)
  89+ 0000              OCC_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_2
  90+ 0000              OCC_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  91+ 0000              OCC_ADDR                equ membank2
  92+ 0000              ; slot 2 also: the 320x256 Layer 2 graphics (layer2-320x256.asm), for the
  93+ 0000              ; screens outside the game (menus, load-out, level complete, game over),
  94+ 0000              ; which never draw the city.  The occlusion page goes back before the game
  95+ 0000              ; (l2_game_mode).
  96+ 0000              L320_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_2
  97+ 0000              L320_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  98+ 0000              L320_ADDR               equ membank2
  99+ 0000
 100+ 0000              ; slot 3: the city bank, always mapped: city_col at $6000, city_map at
 101+ 0000              ; $7000, read from the level's city file (level_load.asm) in one go
 102+ 0000              TABLES_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_3
 103+ 0000              TABLES_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER
 104+ 0000              TABLES_ADDR             equ membank3            ; city_col
 105+ 0000              CITYMAP_ADDR            equ membank3+$1000      ; city_map
 106+ 0000
 107+ 0000              ; slot 4: the ULA screen (bank 5's first 8K: bitmap and attributes)
 108+ 0000              ULA_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_4
 109+ 0000              ULA_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 110+ 0000              ULA_ADDR                equ membank4
 111+ 0000              ; slot 4 also: the second city page (city2.asm), over the ULA screen while
 112+ 0000              ; main_loop draws the city (nothing then uses the ULA screen)
 113+ 0000              CITY2_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_4
 114+ 0000              CITY2_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 115+ 0000              CITY2_ADDR              equ membank4
 116+ 0000
 117+ 0000              ; slot 5: resident main code (zpolice.asm), tables, variables, stack
 118+ 0000              MAIN_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_5
 119+ 0000              MAIN_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER
 120+ 0000              MAIN_ADDR               equ membank5
 121+ 0000
 122+ 0000              ; slot 6: game logic pages, swapped (player, weapons, menu)
 123+ 0000              LOGIC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_6
 124+ 0000              LOGIC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER
 125+ 0000              LOGIC_ADDR              equ membank6
 126+ 0000              ; slot 6 at start-up: the boot stub (the NEX loader maps page 0 there)
 127+ 0000              BOOT_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_6
 128+ 0000              BOOT_ADDR               equ membank6
 129+ 0000
 130+ 0000              ; slot 7: core function pages, swapped (city / Layer 2, HUD, keys, sprites)
 131+ 0000              CODE_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_7
 132+ 0000              CODE_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 133+ 0000              CODE_ADDR               equ membank7
 134+ 0000              ; slot 7 also: a sprite pattern bank (sprite_data.asm), paged in to run
 135+ 0000              ; its own loader, spr_load_bank
 136+ 0000              SPRBANK_SLOT            equ MMU_SLOT_7
 137+ 0000              SPRBANK_MMU             equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 138+ 0000              SPRBANK_ADDR            equ membank7
 139+ 0000
 140+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 141+ 0000              ; 8K pages
 142+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 143+ 0000              PAGE_BOOT               equ 0           ; the NEX entry stub (slot 6 at load)
 144+ 0000              PAGE_CITY               equ 1           ; city.asm: Layer 2 drawing (slot 7)
 145+ 0000              PAGE_HUD                equ 2           ; hud.asm: ULA (Layer 1) HUD (slot 7)
 146+ 0000              PAGE_PLAYER             equ 3           ; player.asm: input, movement,
 147+ 0000                                                      ; collision (slot 6)
 148+ 0000              PAGE_WEAPONS            equ 4           ; weapons.asm: player weapons (slot 6)
 149+ 0000              PAGE_ZOMBIE             equ 5           ; zombie.asm (slot 1, always)
 150+ 0000              PAGE_OCC0               equ 6           ; occlusion buffer, draw list and
 151+ 0000                                                      ; building records (slot 2)
 152+ 0000              PAGE_OCC1               equ 7           ; the city bank: city_col and
 153+ 0000                                                      ; city_map (slot 3, always)
 154+ 0000              PAGE_MENU               equ 8           ; menu.asm: game over, game complete,
 155+ 0000                                                      ; the load error (slot 6)
 156+ 0000              PAGE_SPR0               equ 9           ; sprite_data.asm: sprite pattern
 157+ 0000                                                      ; bank 0 (slot 7 while loading);
 158+ 0000                                                      ; more banks: the next free pages
 159+ 0000              PAGE_ULA0               equ 10          ; the ULA screen, bank 5 (slot 4)
 160+ 0000              PAGE_MAIN               equ 11          ; zpolice.asm, resident (slot 5): the
 161+ 0000                                                      ; second half of bank 5
 162+ 0000              PAGE_INPUT              equ 12          ; input.asm: keyboard, joysticks (slot 7)
 163+ 0000              PAGE_SPRITES            equ 13          ; sprites.asm: hardware sprites
 164+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 7)
 165+ 0000              PAGE_SIN                equ 14          ; sin_tables.asm: the sine table
 166+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 0, read by get_sin)
 167+ 0000              PAGE_INIT               equ 15          ; initialise.asm: start-up set-up,
 168+ 0000                                                      ; initgame (slot 7, once)
 169+ 0000              PAGE_FILE               equ 16          ; file_handler.asm: SD card loading
 170+ 0000                                                      ; and saving (slot 7)
 171+ 0000              PAGE_AUDIO              equ 17          ; audio.asm: sound set-up (slot 7)
 172+ 0000              PAGE_SPECIAL            equ 31          ; specials.asm: special monsters
 173+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 6)
 174+ 0000              PAGE_LOADOUT            equ 32          ; loadout.asm: the load-out screen
 175+ 0000                                                      ; between levels (slot 6)
 176+ 0000              PAGE_KEYDEF             equ 33          ; keydef.asm: the redefine keys
 177+ 0000                                                      ; screen (slot 6)
 178+ 0000              PAGE_CITY2              equ 34          ; city2.asm: more Layer 2 drawing
 179+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 4, with the city page)
 180+ 0000              PAGE_L320               equ 35          ; layer2-320x256.asm: Layer 2 320x256
 181+ 0000                                                      ; graphics for the menu screens (slot 2)
 182+ 0000              PAGE_MAINMENU           equ 36          ; mainmenu.asm: the main menu (slot 6)
 183+ 0000              PAGE_LEVELEND           equ 37          ; levelend.asm: level complete (slot 6)
 184+ 0000              PAGE_L320_BG            equ 86          ; 86-95: a copy of a 320x256 screen's
 185+ 0000                                                      ; background (l320_bg_save), to put back
 186+ 0000                                                      ; under text that changes (l320_restore)
 187+ 0000              PAGE_GFX0               equ 38          ; the figures' graphics (from page 38,
 188+ 0000                                                      ; GFX_PAGES_MAX at most), loaded from
 189+ 0000                                                      ; ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG at start-up; each
 190+ 0000                                                      ; mapped at $C000 (slot 6) to draw
 191+ 0000              PAGE_LEVEL              equ 30          ; level_load.asm: level and city
 192+ 0000                                                      ; files (slot 6); pages 18-29 are
 193+ 0000                                                      ; the Layer 2 buffers
 194+ 0000
 195+ 0000              ; Layer 2 double buffer, in 16K banks (NextReg $12 / $13 take banks; the
 196+ 0000              ; pages are bank * 2).  Layer 2 is clipped to 192 rows, so each buffer
 197+ 0000              ; uses three banks.
 198+ 0000              L2_BANK_A               equ 9           ; 16K banks 9-11 (pages 18-23)
 199+ 0000              L2_BANK_B               equ 12          ; 16K banks 12-14 (pages 24-29)
 200+ 0000              PAGE_L2_A               equ L2_BANK_A*2
 201+ 0000              PAGE_L2_B               equ L2_BANK_B*2
 202+ 0000

 127  0000
 128  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 129  0000              ; Tuning constants
 130  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 131  0000              ; Scale: one map tile (cell) is 20 m x 20 m = 256 world units, and one
 132  0000              ; height unit (building heights, the ceiling, the pad) is 10 m = 128 world
 133  0000              ; units.  World units are the same size on every axis, so 1 m = 12.8 units
 134  0000              ; and 1 unit = 7.8 cm.  The city is 64 x 64 tiles = 1280 m.
 135  0000              ; Speeds are per rendered frame, so real speed depends on the frame rate
 136  0000              ; (figures below are at 14 fps).
 137  0000              GRID            equ 64          ; the city is GRID x GRID tiles (gentables.py)
 138  0000              ; A city_map byte: bits 0-4 the cell code (0 road, 1-15 building height
 139  0000              ; level, PAD_CODE, TERRACE_CODE, VOID_CODE: out of bounds), bit 6 set while a human waits in the cell
 140  0000              ; (human.asm, hum_flags), bit 7 while a zombie or special monster stands in
 141  0000              ; it (zombie.asm, zflags; its type is in its record).  Bit 5 is free.  So
 142  0000              ; every reader masks with CELL_CODE before testing for road or a code.
 143  0000              CELL_CODE       equ %00011111
 144  0000              CELL_FLAGS      equ %11100000       ; (the marks, kept when the code changes)
 145  0000              CELL_HUMAN_B    equ 6
 146  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE_B   equ 7
 147  0000              CELL_HUMAN      equ 1<<CELL_HUMAN_B
 148  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE     equ 1<<CELL_ZOMBIE_B
 149  0000              TILE_M          equ 20          ; metres per tile (reference scale)
 150  0000              TILE_UNITS      equ 256         ; world units per tile
 151  0000              HEIGHT_M        equ 10          ; metres per height unit
 152  0000              HEIGHT_UNITS    equ 128         ; world units per height unit
 153  0000              NEAR            equ 16          ; near clip plane: 1.25 m
 154  0000              VIEW_R          equ 8           ; most draw distance: buildings within +/- 8

 693  0000              ; HL = HL * GRID  (a map row offset)
 694  0000              ; DE = -DE (vproj)
 695  0000                      MACRO NEG_DE
 696  0000 ~                    xor a
 697  0000 ~                    sub e
 698  0000 ~                    ld e,a
 699  0000 ~                    sbc a,a
 700  0000 ~                    sub d
 701  0000 ~                    ld d,a
 702  0000                      ENDM
 703  0000
 704  0000              ; HL = n (>= 0), BC = R (zpatch's reciprocal for Z) -> A = round(n * 128 /
 705  0000              ; Z) as scale_comp, after its shift: n over 511 clamped; P = n_lo R / 256 +
 706  0000              ; 256 (the rounding, first: at most 65535), plus R if bit 8 of n is set (the
 707  0000              ; carry bit 16); A = bits 9-16 of P.  Uses DE.  (vproj)
 708  0000                      MACRO VP_SCALE
 709  0000 ~                    ld a,h
 710  0000 ~                    cp 2
 711  0000 ~                    jr c,$+5
 712  0000 ~                    ld hl,511
 713  0000 ~                    ld d,l
 714  0000 ~                    ld e,c
 715  0000 ~                    mul d,e                         ; n_lo Rl
 716  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 717  0000 ~                    ld d,l
 718  0000 ~                    ld e,b
 719  0000 ~                    mul d,e                         ; n_lo Rh
 720  0000 ~                    add a,e
 721  0000 ~                    ld e,a
 722  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 723  0000 ~                    adc a,1
 724  0000 ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = n_lo R / 256 + 256, carry 0
 725  0000 ~                    bit 0,h
 726  0000 ~                    jr z,$+5
 727  0000 ~                    ex de,hl
 728  0000 ~                    add hl,bc                       ; + 256 n_hi R / 256: carry = bit 16
 729  0000 ~                    ex de,hl
 730  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 731  0000 ~                    rra
 732  0000                      ENDM
 733  0000
 734  0000              ; The cell walks' call of try_cell (draw_row, occ_row), skipped for a cell
 735  0000              ; whose centre (the walk's yaw-space X, Z1 in HL', DE') is surely out of
 736  0000              ; view: in level flight |X| - Z1 >= WALK_R (outside the left or right
 737  0000              ; edge), pitched Z1 < -WALK_R (behind: no multiply by draw_bld's cull_c).
 738  0000              ; WALK_R is over draw_bld's BLD_R, so every building it skips draw_bld
 739  0000              ; would reject, and the 64 over leaves room for a figure standing at a
 740  0000              ; street cell's edge (an off-screen figure draws nothing and notes
 741  0000              ; nothing: fig_draw returns before fig_seen).  The walk still steps every
 742  0000              ; cell, so the cells drawn have the same positions.  Uses A, BC'.
 743  0000              WALK_R          equ 320
 744  0000                      MACRO WALK_TRY
 745  0000 ~                    exx
 746  0000 ~                    ld a,(pitch)
 747  0000 ~                    or a
 748  0000 ~                    jr nz,.pt
 749  0000 ~                    ld b,h
 750  0000 ~                    ld c,l
 751  0000 ~                    bit 7,b
 752  0000 ~                    jr z,.ap
 753  0000 ~                    xor a
 754  0000 ~                    sub c
 755  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 756  0000 ~                    sbc a,a
 757  0000 ~                    sub b
 758  0000 ~                    ld b,a                          ; |X|
 759  0000 ~            .ap:    ld a,c
 760  0000 ~                    sub e
 761  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 762  0000 ~                    ld a,b
 763  0000 ~                    sbc a,d
 764  0000 ~                    ld b,a                          ; |X| - Z1
 765  0000 ~                    ld a,c
 766  0000 ~                    sub low WALK_R
 767  0000 ~                    ld a,b
 768  0000 ~                    sbc a,high WALK_R
 769  0000 ~                    exx
 770  0000 ~                    jp p,.out                       ; |X| - Z1 >= WALK_R
 771  0000 ~                    jr .try
 772  0000 ~            .pt:    ld a,e
 773  0000 ~                    add a,low WALK_R
 774  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 775  0000 ~                    adc a,high WALK_R
 776  0000 ~                    exx
 777  0000 ~                    jp m,.out                       ; Z1 + WALK_R < 0
 778  0000 ~            .try:   call try_cell
 779  0000 ~            .out:
 780  0000                      ENDM

 782  0000                      MACRO ROWOFS
 783  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 784  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 785  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 786  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 787  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 788  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 789  0000                      ENDM
 790  0000
 791  0000              ; A building's 8 corners (vtx, 16 bytes each; index = x + 2*z + 4*top) from
 792  0000              ; corner 0, component C (0 X, 2 Y, 4 Z) at a time: v1 = v0 + vx, v3 = v1 +
 793  0000              ; vz, v2 = v0 + vz (vx, vz: vecs0, its edge vectors), and each top corner
 794  0000              ; its bottom corner + vy (vy_vec, the vertical edge).  The sums the corners
 795  0000              ; share are made once, in registers (draw_bld, city.asm).
 796  0000                      MACRO VBOX C
 797  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 798  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)                 ; vx
 799  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)               ; vz
 800  0000 ~                    push hl
 801  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 802  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 803  0000 ~                    push hl
 804  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 805  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 806  0000 ~                    ld de,(vy_vec+C)                ; vy
 807  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 808  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7 = v3 + vy
 809  0000 ~                    pop hl
 810  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 811  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5 = v1 + vy
 812  0000 ~                    pop hl
 813  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 814  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 815  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 816  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6 = v2 + vy
 817  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)
 818  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 819  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0 + vy
 820  0000                      ENDM
 821  0000              ; The same for a component of vy that is 0 (X always; Z in level flight):
 822  0000              ; each top corner is its bottom corner
 823  0000                      MACRO VBOX0 C
 824  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 825  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0
 826  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)
 827  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)
 828  0000 ~                    push hl
 829  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 830  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 831  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5
 832  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 833  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 834  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7
 835  0000 ~                    pop hl
 836  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 837  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 838  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6
 839  0000                      ENDM

 841  0000              ; Copy cached screen corner of face vertex (HL)+ into p2buf (DE)+ with the
 842  0000              ; outline flag for edge bit EB taken from df_mask.  B = high vtx.
 843  0000                      MACRO FACEVTX EB
 844  0000 ~                    ld a,(hl)
 845  0000 ~                    inc hl
 846  0000 ~                    add a,7
 847  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 848  0000 ~                    ld a,(bc)
 849  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 850  0000 ~                    inc e

 853  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 854  0000 ~                    inc e

 857  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 858  0000 ~                    inc e
 859  0000 ~                    inc e

 885  A057                      INCLUDE "levels.asm"            ; the current level's record
# file opened: levels.asm
   1+ A057              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A057              ; Z-POLICE - the current level's settings (resident, so any page can read
   3+ A057              ; them)
   4+ A057              ;
   5+ A057              ; level_cur holds the record of the level being played, loaded from its file
   6+ A057              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL by load_level (level_load.asm).  LV_SIZE bytes:
   7+ A057              ;   +0  LV_NUM          level number
   8+ A057              ;   +1  LV_NAME         city name, 8 characters (ASCII, space padded)
   9+ A057              ;   +9  LV_ZOMBIES      number of zombies a wave (at most NZOMB)
  10+ A057              ;   +10 LV_WAVES        number of zombie waves (1..LV_MAX_WAVES)
  11+ A057              ;   +11 LV_FAST         number of fast zombies (of LV_ZOMBIES)
  12+ A057              ;   +12 LV_VIEW_R       draw distance in tiles, 2..VIEW_R (fewer: night or
  13+ A057              ;                       fog); load_level sets view_r / dot_r from it
  14+ A057              ;   +13 LV_WAVE_DATA    the special monsters of each wave, waves 1 to
  15+ A057              ;                       LV_MAX_WAVES (wave 1 is the level's start), LV_WAVE_REC
  16+ A057              ;                       bytes each:
  17+ A057              ;         +0  LV_SPECIAL_ID   LV_SPEC_SLOTS special types (SPEC_*;
  18+ A057              ;                             SPEC_NONE, 255: none in that place)
  19+ A057              ;         +5  LV_SPECIAL      how many of each (in the same places)
  20+ A057              ; The levels and their cities are made by gentables.py (ZPDATA/); a level
  21+ A057              ; file can be replaced by a hand-made one (or its text form, .TXL, edited).
  22+ A057              ;==============================================================================
  23+ A057
  24+ A057              LV_NUM          equ 0
  25+ A057              LV_NAME         equ 1
  26+ A057              LV_NAME_LEN     equ 8
  27+ A057              LV_ZOMBIES      equ LV_NAME+LV_NAME_LEN
  28+ A057              LV_WAVES        equ LV_ZOMBIES+1
  29+ A057              LV_FAST         equ LV_WAVES+1
  30+ A057              LV_VIEW_R       equ LV_FAST+1
  31+ A057              LV_WAVE_DATA    equ LV_VIEW_R+1
  32+ A057              LV_MAX_WAVES    equ 10              ; waves a level can have specials for
  33+ A057              LV_SPEC_SLOTS   equ 5               ; special types a wave
  34+ A057              LV_SPECIAL_ID   equ 0               ; (in a wave's data) the types,
  35+ A057              LV_SPECIAL      equ LV_SPEC_SLOTS   ;   then how many of each
  36+ A057              LV_WAVE_REC     equ 2*LV_SPEC_SLOTS
  37+ A057              LV_SIZE         equ LV_WAVE_DATA+LV_MAX_WAVES*LV_WAVE_REC   ; 113 bytes
  38+ A057                      ASSERT LV_SIZE == 113           ; (gentables.py writes it)
  39+ A057              ; Special monster types in the level files (specials.asm: spec_types)
  40+ A057              SPEC_GHOST      equ 0
  41+ A057              SPEC_BANSHEE    equ 1
  42+ A057              SPEC_GHOUL      equ 2
  43+ A057              SPEC_LICH       equ 3
  44+ A057              SPEC_IDS        equ 4               ; (how many types)
  45+ A057              SPEC_CLUSTER    equ 4               ; not a monster: the wave's zombies spawn in
  46+ A057                                                  ; this many clusters (zcluster, zombie.asm)
  47+ A057                      ASSERT SPEC_CLUSTER >= SPEC_IDS ; (spec_wave skips it)
  48+ A057              SPEC_NONE       equ 255
  49+ A057
  50+ A057              ; -> HL = the current level's record
  51+ A057              level_entry:
  52+ A057 21 5B A0             ld hl,level_cur
  53+ A05A C9                   ret
  54+ A05B
  55+ A05B 00 00 00...  level_cur:  ds LV_SIZE                  ; the level being played (load_level)
  56+ A0CC
# file closed: levels.asm
 886  A0CC                      INCLUDE "text.asm"              ; text screens: menu, load-out
# file opened: text.asm
   1+ A0CC              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A0CC              ; Z-POLICE - text screens (resident): the ULA routines the end screens
   3+ A0CC              ; (menu.asm) and the load-out screen (loadout.asm) share, from whichever
   4+ A0CC              ; page is in slot 6.  Layer 2 hidden, the ULA screen with opaque paper,
   5+ A0CC              ; 8x8 characters (font8, ASCII 32-95) by row and column with an attribute.
   6+ A0CC              ; And screen320, the start of a Layer 2 320x256 screen (the main menu and
   7+ A0CC              ; redefine keys: layer2-320x256.asm draws them).
   8+ A0CC              ;==============================================================================
   9+ A0CC
  10+ A0CC              MENU_ATTR       equ P_PANEL<<3 | 7          ; white on the panel colour
  11+ A0CC              MENU_TITLE      equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_YEL      ; yellow
  12+ A0CC              MENU_OK         equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_OK       ; green
  13+ A0CC              MENU_BAD        equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_WARN     ; red
  14+ A0CC
  15+ A0CC              ; A Layer 2 320x256 screen (the main menu, redefine keys): sprites hidden,
  16+ A0CC              ; the AY chips silent, the keys in slot 7, the 320x256 page in slot 2 (and
  17+ A0CC              ; left there: the screen draws with it), cleared with a frame and shown
  18+ A0CC              ; (l320_screen, layer2-320x256.asm)
  19+ A0CC              screen320:
  20+ A0CC CD D6 A0             call menu_quiet
  21+ A0CF ED 91 52 23          nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320
  22+ A0D3 C3 8D 40             jp l320_screen
  23+ A0D6
  24+ A0D6              ; No HUD sprites, silence (the engines off), and the input page in slot 7
  25+ A0D6              ; (the screens read the keys)
  26+ A0D6              menu_quiet:
  27+ A0D6 ED 91 57 0D          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES
  28+ A0DA CD E5 E0             call spr_hide_all
  29+ A0DD CD 2E E0             call spr_update
  30+ A0E0 ED 91 57 11          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO
  31+ A0E4 CD 00 E0             call init_audio                 ; (audio.asm)
  32+ A0E7 ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT
  33+ A0EB C9                   ret
  34+ A0EC
  35+ A0EC              ; A ULA screen: hide Layer 2 (at 256x192 again, if a 320x256 screen had it),
  36+ A0EC              ; silence the AY chips, and blank the ULA screen with opaque paper
  37+ A0EC              menu_clear:
  38+ A0EC CD D6 A0             call menu_quiet
  39+ A0EF CD 72 AA             call l2_game_mode               ; (zpolice.asm)
  40+ A0F2 01 3B 12             ld bc,$123B
  41+ A0F5 AF                   xor a
  42+ A0F6 ED 79                out (c),a
  43+ A0F8 21 00 80             ld hl,ULA_BMP                   ; (by DMA: layer2_cls.asm)
  44+ A0FB 01 00 18             ld bc,$1800
  45+ A0FE AF                   xor a
  46+ A0FF CD 10 A8             call dma_fill
  47+ A102 21 00 98             ld hl,ULA_ATTR
  48+ A105 01 00 03             ld bc,$300
  49+ A108 3E 0F                ld a,MENU_ATTR
  50+ A10A C3 10 A8             jp dma_fill
  51+ A10D
  52+ A10D              ; D = character row, E = column, C = attribute, HL -> text ending 0.
  53+ A10D              ; Prints it; HL ends past the 0.
  54+ A10D              menu_print:
  55+ A10D 7E           .ch:    ld a,(hl)
  56+ A10E 23                   inc hl
  57+ A10F B7                   or a
  58+ A110 C8                   ret z
  59+ A111 E5                   push hl
  60+ A112 D5                   push de
  61+ A113 C5                   push bc
  62+ A114 CD 1D A1             call menu_char
  63+ A117 C1                   pop bc
  64+ A118 D1                   pop de
  65+ A119 E1                   pop hl
  66+ A11A 1C                   inc e
  67+ A11B 18 F0                jr .ch
  68+ A11D
  69+ A11D              ; A = ASCII 32-95, D = row, E = column, C = attribute: draw one character
  70+ A11D              menu_char:
  71+ A11D D6 20                sub 32
  72+ A11F 6F                   ld l,a
  73+ A120 26 00                ld h,0
  74+ A122 29                   add hl,hl
  75+ A123 29                   add hl,hl
  76+ A124 29                   add hl,hl
  77+ A125 D5                   push de
  78+ A126 11 86 A1             ld de,font8
  79+ A129 19                   add hl,de                       ; HL -> its 8 bytes
  80+ A12A D1                   pop de
  81+ A12B D5                   push de
  82+ A12C 7A                   ld a,d                          ; attribute: ULA_ATTR + row*32 + col
  83+ A12D 0F                   rrca
  84+ A12E 0F                   rrca
  85+ A12F 0F                   rrca
  86+ A130 47                   ld b,a
  87+ A131 E6 E0                and %11100000
  88+ A133 B3                   or e
  89+ A134 E5                   push hl
  90+ A135 6F                   ld l,a
  91+ A136 78                   ld a,b
  92+ A137 E6 03                and %00000011
  93+ A139 C6 98                add a,high ULA_ATTR
  94+ A13B 67                   ld h,a
  95+ A13C 71                   ld (hl),c
  96+ A13D E1                   pop hl
  97+ A13E D1                   pop de
  98+ A13F 7A                   ld a,d                          ; bitmap: third, row in third, column
  99+ A140 E6 18                and %00011000
 100+ A142 C6 80                add a,high ULA_BMP
 101+ A144 47                   ld b,a
 102+ A145 7A                   ld a,d
 103+ A146 E6 07                and 7
 104+ A148 0F                   rrca
 105+ A149 0F                   rrca
 106+ A14A 0F                   rrca
 107+ A14B B3                   or e
 108+ A14C 5F                   ld e,a
 109+ A14D 50                   ld d,b                          ; DE -> the cell's top line
 110+ A14E 06 08                ld b,8
 111+ A150 7E           .l:     ld a,(hl)
 112+ A151 12                   ld (de),a
 113+ A152 23                   inc hl
 114+ A153 14                   inc d
 115+ A154 10 FA                djnz .l
 116+ A156 C9                   ret
 117+ A157
 118+ A157              ; Wait for the start of the next video frame (the raster reaching line 192)
 119+ A157              menu_frame:
 120+ A157 CD 62 A1     .in:    call menu_line                  ; let any current blanking end
 121+ A15A 30 FB                jr nc,.in
 122+ A15C CD 62 A1     .out:   call menu_line                  ; then wait for the next one
 123+ A15F 38 FB                jr c,.out
 124+ A161 C9                   ret
 125+ A162
 126+ A162              ; Carry clear if the raster is at line 192 or later (blanking).  The line is
 127+ A162              ; read as high byte ($1E), low byte ($1F), high byte again: if the high
 128+ A162              ; byte changed in between (line 255 -> 256) the pair is torn, so read again.
 129+ A162              menu_line:
 130+ A162 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 131+ A165 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 132+ A167 ED 79                out (c),a
 133+ A169 04                   inc b
 134+ A16A ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; high byte
 135+ A16C 05                   dec b
 136+ A16D 3E 1F                ld a,$1F
 137+ A16F ED 79                out (c),a
 138+ A171 04                   inc b
 139+ A172 ED 50                in d,(c)                        ; low byte
 140+ A174 05                   dec b
 141+ A175 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 142+ A177 ED 79                out (c),a
 143+ A179 04                   inc b
 144+ A17A ED 78                in a,(c)
 145+ A17C BB                   cp e
 146+ A17D 20 E3                jr nz,menu_line                 ; torn: again
 147+ A17F E6 01                and 1
 148+ A181 C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256 (carry clear)
 149+ A182 7A                   ld a,d
 150+ A183 FE C0                cp 192
 151+ A185 C9                   ret

 887  A386                      INCLUDE "sfx_data.asm"          ; the sound effects (sfx_tick plays them)
# file opened: sfx_data.asm
   1+ A386              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A386              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (resident: the main page, slot 5, always
   3+ A386              ; mapped, so the interrupt routine can read it whatever else is paged in)
   4+ A386              ;
   5+ A386              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ A386              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ A386              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ A386              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ A386              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ A386              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ A386              ;==============================================================================
  12+ A386
  13+ A386              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ A386              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ A386                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ A386 ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ A386 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ A386 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ A386                  ENDM
  20+ A386
  21+ A386              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ A386                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ A386 ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ A386                  ENDM
  25+ A386
  26+ A386              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ A386              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ A386              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ A386              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ A386              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ A386                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ A386 ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ A386 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ A386 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ A386 ~                    DUP len
  36+ A386 ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ A386 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ A386 ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ A386 ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ A386 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ A386 ~                    EDUP
  42+ A386 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  43+ A386                  ENDM
  44+ A386
  45+ A386              ; One step of a splat: channel C (only: see sfx_tick) at tone period p,
  46+ A386              ; volume v
  47+ A386                  MACRO SFX_SPLAT_STEP p, v
  48+ A386 ~                    db AY_TONE_C, low (p), AY_TONE_C+1, high (p), AY_VOL_C, v, SFX_STEP
  49+ A386                  ENDM
  50+ A386
  51+ A386              ; The sounds, by number (SFX_*, from 1)
  52+ A386              sfx_table:

  65+ A39E DB A6                dw sfx_lock                     ; SFX_LOCK

  34+ A7FD              DDMA_MODE                    equ $df    ; then the flags: each sets them all

  36+ A7FD              DDMA_FLAG_FILL               equ %00001000

  59+ A810              ; DMA fill: HL = destination, BC = length (non-zero), A = the byte.  Any
  60+ A810              ; memory mapped in now (the Layer 2 sections in slot 0, the occlusion page,
  61+ A810              ; the ULA screen).  Resident (the main page, with this block), so the city,
  62+ A810              ; HUD and menu pages all use it.  It leaves the length's high byte set:
  63+ A810              ; fill_spans needs it 0 (clear_screen.spans), so the city page restores it
  64+ A810              ; after a fill of its own.

 910  A84E ED 5F                ld a,r                          ; random seed (xorshift: non-zero);

 912  A851 26 A5                ld h,$A5

 914  A856 ED 91 52 23          nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320      ; the fonts' files, if any (layer2-
 915  A85A CD EF 42             call fonts_load                 ; 320x256.asm; after the seed: R
 916  A85D ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0       ; counts the code before it)
 917  A861 ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; the extended keys only in their own

 919  A868                                                      ; also CAPS SHIFT + SPACE, fire)
 920  A868 ED 91 57 02          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_HUD
 921  A86C CD 15 E0             call ula_palette                ; ULA inks and papers (menu and HUD)
 922  A86F ED 91 57 0D          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES
 923  A873 CD 00 E0             call sprites_init               ; (sprites.asm) on, all hidden
 924  A876 ED 91 57 09          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPR0      ; sprite bank 0: the human status
 925  A87A CD 00 E0             call spr_load_bank              ; sprites (sprite_data.asm)
 926  A87D FB                   ei                              ; interrupts on, from now on (the
 927  A87E                                                      ; engines' sound: interrupts.asm)

 930  A881              ;==============================================================================
 931  A881              ; New game: start level 1.  Start-up has set the hardware (speed, layers,
 932  A881              ; clip window, palettes, memory map), which the menu leaves alone; here the
 933  A881              ; game state and the screen contents are set up from scratch, so this also
 934  A881              ; works for a second game.
 935  A881              ;==============================================================================
 936  A881              newGame:

 940  A88A                                                      ; first level (next_level)
 941  A88A
 942  A88A              ; A new game's state: the player, weapons, store, salvage, booster (and the
 943  A88A              ; debug load-out), level START_LEVEL.  (CONTINUE lays a save game over it:
 944  A88A              ; continue_game.)

 985  A8E4 32 6D B0             ld (boost_fitted),a             ; no booster (a salvage reward)

 989  A8F0 32 69 B0             ld (vthrust_fitted),a           ; no vertical thrusters (salvage)
 990  A8F3 32 6A B0             ld (lthrust_fitted),a           ; nor lateral ones

1004  A90D 10 EF                djnz .dbg

1009  A919                  ENDIF

1023  A92F              ; Start the level `level`: from the load-out screen, after newGame and after
1024  A92F              ; each level completed (level_complete_screen).  The VTOL goes back onto the base pad, level and
1025  A92F              ; still; its hit points, weapons and ammo carry on.  The level's files are
1026  A92F              ; loaded and everything in the city is set up afresh.

1066  A993                                                      ; had it at 320x256
1067  A993                      ; clear both buffers

1069  A997 3E 40                ld a,VIEW_CY
1070  A999 32 C9 B6             ld (horizon),a
1071  A99C 3E 12                ld a,PAGE_L2_A
1072  A99E 32 F0 B6             ld (seg_base),a
1073  A9A1 CD 5B F2             call clear_screen
1074  A9A4 3E 18                ld a,PAGE_L2_B
1075  A9A6 32 F0 B6             ld (seg_base),a
1076  A9A9 CD 5B F2             call clear_screen
1077  A9AC ED 91 12 09          nextreg $12,L2_BANK_A           ; Layer 2 active (displayed) bank
1078  A9B0 ED 91 13 0C          nextreg $13,L2_BANK_B           ; Layer 2 shadow bank (drawn into)
1079  A9B4 01 3B 12             ld bc,$123B
1080  A9B7 3E 02                ld a,%00000010                  ; Layer 2 visible (the menu hid it)
1081  A9B9 ED 79                out (c),a
1082  A9BB ED 91 57 02          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_HUD
1083  A9BF CD 72 E0             call ula_init                   ; ULA: FPS overlay, panel, city map
1084  A9C2 CD 00 20             call zombie_init                ; place the zombies on the streets
1085  A9C5 CD 82 30             call human_init                 ; and the humans to rescue
1086  A9C8 ED 91 56 1F          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_SPECIAL  ; and the level's special monsters
1087  A9CC CD 00 C0             call spec_init                  ; (specials.asm)

1089  A9CF              ;==============================================================================
1090  A9CF              ; Main loop
1091  A9CF              ;==============================================================================
1092  A9CF              main_loop:
1093  A9CF ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; input at $E000, while the logic runs
1094  A9D3 CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan                   ; all key and joystick banks
1095  A9D6 3E 12                ld a,K_PAUSE                    ; paused until the pause control is
1096  A9D8 CD CF E0             call key_pressed                ; pressed again
1097  A9DB C4 6C AB             call nz,game_pause
1098  A9DE 3E 14                ld a,K_VISION                   ; the next vision mode the VTOL has
1099  A9E0 CD CF E0             call key_pressed                ; (level_load.asm: its palettes are
1100  A9E3 28 07                jr z,.nv                        ; there)
1101  A9E5 ED 91 56 1E          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_LEVEL
1102  A9E9 CD 73 C1             call vis_cycle
1103  A9EC              .nv:
1104  A9EC ED 91 56 03          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_PLAYER   ; input/movement logic at $C000
1105  A9F0 CD 00 C0             call update_player
1106  A9F3 CD 51 AE             call setup_frame

1108  A9F9 ED 91 56 1F          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_SPECIAL  ; and fly the special monsters
1109  A9FD CD AA C0             call spec_update                ; (specials.asm)
1110  AA00 ED 91 56 04          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS  ; weapons logic at $C000
1111  AA04 CD 00 C0             call update_weapons             ; fire, move rounds, hits

1123  AA24              .go:

1133  AA32                  ENDIF

1137  AA35                  ENDIF

1141  AA3E CD D2 84             call draw_gunsight

1146  AA4F                  IFDEF WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
1147  AA4F ~                    call wait_vblank
1148  AA4F                  ENDIF

1150  AA52 CD 91 AA             call shake_tick                 ; a crash: the view shaken
1151  AA55                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1152  AA55 ~                    call fps_tick                   ; HUD page is still at $E000
1153  AA55                  ENDIF

1155  AA59 CD DC E2             call hud_sprites                ; (hud_sprites.asm), with the new frame
1156  AA5C C3 CF A9             jp main_loop
1157  AA5F
1158  AA5F              ;==============================================================================
1159  AA5F              ; Frames per second, shown on the ULA layer above Layer 2.
1160  AA5F              ;
1161  AA5F              ; Interrupts stay off (the span filler borrows SP), so time is taken from the
1162  AA5F              ; raster: vtick reads the current video line and counts a new 50Hz video
1163  AA5F              ; frame whenever the line number has gone backwards.  It must be called at
1164  AA5F              ; least once per video frame (~560K T at 28MHz); the main loop and draw_cell
1165  AA5F              ; do that.  Every 50 video frames (1 second) the number of frames rendered
1166  AA5F              ; becomes the FPS figure.
1167  AA5F              ;==============================================================================
1168  AA5F                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1169  AA5F ~            vtick:
1170  AA5F ~                    ld bc,$243B
1171  AA5F ~                    ld a,$1E
1172  AA5F ~                    out (c),a
1173  AA5F ~                    inc b
1174  AA5F ~                    in d,(c)                        ; line MSB
1175  AA5F ~                    dec b
1176  AA5F ~                    ld a,$1F
1177  AA5F ~                    out (c),a
1178  AA5F ~                    inc b
1179  AA5F ~                    in e,(c)                        ; line LSB
1180  AA5F ~                    dec b
1181  AA5F ~                    ld a,$1E
1182  AA5F ~                    out (c),a
1183  AA5F ~                    inc b
1184  AA5F ~                    in a,(c)
1185  AA5F ~                    cp d
1186  AA5F ~                    jr nz,vtick                     ; MSB changed mid-read: try again
1187  AA5F ~                    and 1
1188  AA5F ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = video line 0..311
1189  AA5F ~                    ld hl,(fps_line)
1190  AA5F ~                    ld (fps_line),de
1191  AA5F ~                    or a
1192  AA5F ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; previous - current
1193  AA5F ~                    ret c
1194  AA5F ~                    ret z
1195  AA5F ~                    ld hl,fps_vframes               ; line went backwards: new frame
1196  AA5F ~                    inc (hl)
1197  AA5F ~                    ret
1198  AA5F ~
1199  AA5F ~            ; Once per rendered frame, after the flip
1200  AA5F ~            fps_tick:
1201  AA5F ~                    call vtick
1202  AA5F ~                    ld hl,fps_count
1203  AA5F ~                    inc (hl)
1204  AA5F ~                    ld a,(fps_vframes)
1205  AA5F ~                    cp 50
1206  AA5F ~                    ret c
1207  AA5F ~                    sub 50
1208  AA5F ~                    ld (fps_vframes),a
1209  AA5F ~                    ld a,(fps_count)
1210  AA5F ~                    ld (fps_value),a
1211  AA5F ~                    xor a
1212  AA5F ~                    ld (fps_count),a
1213  AA5F ~                    jp fps_draw                     ; HUD page (paged in by main_loop)
1214  AA5F                  ENDIF
1215  AA5F
1216  AA5F              ; A = NextReg number -> A = its value
1217  AA5F              read_nextreg:
1218  AA5F 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1219  AA62 ED 79                out (c),a
1220  AA64 04                   inc b
1221  AA65 ED 78                in a,(c)
1222  AA67 C9                   ret
1223  AA68
1224  AA68              ; Select the shadow Layer 2 buffer for drawing: remember the 8K page of its
1225  AA68              ; first row.  Sections are then paged in on demand by seg_map / line_seg.
1226  AA68              map_shadow:
1227  AA68 3E 13                ld a,$13
1228  AA6A CD 5F AA             call read_nextreg
1229  AA6D 87                   add a,a                         ; 16K bank -> 8K page
1230  AA6E 32 F0 B6             ld (seg_base),a
1231  AA71 C9                   ret
1232  AA72
1233  AA72              ; Back from the screens outside the game (320x256, layer2-320x256.asm) to
1234  AA72              ; the game's Layer 2, 256x192 and hidden, and the occlusion page back in
1235  AA72              ; slot 2 where the 320x256 page was.  (Nothing changes if it wasn't.)
1236  AA72              l2_game_mode:
1237  AA72 ED 91 52 23          nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320
1238  AA76 CD 56 40             call l320_mode256
1239  AA79 ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0
1240  AA7D C9                   ret
1241  AA7E
1242  AA7E              ; Show the shadow buffer and make the old active buffer the new shadow
1243  AA7E              l2_flip:
1244  AA7E 3E 12                ld a,$12
1245  AA80 CD 5F AA             call read_nextreg
1246  AA83 5F                   ld e,a                          ; old active
1247  AA84 3E 13                ld a,$13
1248  AA86 CD 5F AA             call read_nextreg
1249  AA89 ED 92 12             nextreg $12,a                   ; shadow -> active
1250  AA8C 7B                   ld a,e
1251  AA8D ED 92 13             nextreg $13,a                   ; old active -> shadow
1252  AA90 C9                   ret
1253  AA91
1254  AA91              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1255  AA91              ; Layer 2 writes go through MMU slot 0 ($0000-$1FFF) only.  Each 8K page of
1256  AA91              ; the buffer is a 32-row section, so row y is page seg_base + y/32 and its
1257  AA91              ; pixels are at (y & 31)*256 + x.  Sections are paged in as drawing reaches
1258  AA91              ; them.  Slots 4-5 keep the ULA screen.
1259  AA91              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1260  AA91
1261  AA91              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1262  AA91              ; Screen shake, when the VTOL hits a building (player.asm sets shake_t to
1263  AA91              ; SHAKE_LEN).  Each rendered frame, as it is shown, the Layer 2 view is
1264  AA91              ; offset by the next pair of shake_xy through the scroll registers, a pixel
1265  AA91              ; or two each way, dying away; the last pair (0, 0) puts it back.  Only
1266  AA91              ; Layer 2 moves: the HUD is on the ULA.  (X wraps at 256, Y at 192: -n is
1267  AA91              ; 256-n and 192-n.  An edge row or column of the view shows the far side's
1268  AA91              ; meanwhile.)
1269  AA91              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1270  AA91              SHAKE_LEN       equ 6               ; rendered frames (about half a second)
1271  AA91              shake_tick:
1272  AA91 3A C3 AA             ld a,(shake_t)
1273  AA94 B7                   or a
1274  AA95 C8                   ret z
1275  AA96 3D                   dec a
1276  AA97 32 C3 AA             ld (shake_t),a
1277  AA9A 87                   add a,a
1278  AA9B 21 B7 AA             ld hl,shake_xy
1279  AA9E ED 31                add hl,a
1280  AAA0 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1281  AAA1 ED 92 16             nextreg $16,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
1282  AAA4 23                   inc hl
1283  AAA5 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1284  AAA6 ED 92 17             nextreg $17,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
1285  AAA9 C9                   ret
1286  AAAA
1287  AAAA              ; Stop any shake: the view back in place
1288  AAAA              shake_off:
1289  AAAA AF                   xor a
1290  AAAB 32 C3 AA             ld (shake_t),a
1291  AAAE ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0
1292  AAB2 ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0
1293  AAB6 C9                   ret
1294  AAB7
1295  AAB7              ; (x, y) pixels, used from the last pair back to the first
1296  AAB7 00 00 01 00  shake_xy:   db 0,0, 1,0, 256-1,192-1, 1,1, 256-2,192-1, 2,1
1296  AABB FF BF 01 01
1296  AABF FE BF 02 01
1297  AAC3                      ASSERT $ - shake_xy == 2*SHAKE_LEN
1298  AAC3 00           shake_t:    db 0                        ; frames of shake left (0: none)
1299  AAC4 00           gfx_ok:     db 0                        ; 1: the figures' graphics are loaded
1300  AAC5
1301  AAC5              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1302  AAC5              ; Wait until the raster is outside the display area (line >= 192)
1303  AAC5              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1304  AAC5              wait_vblank:
1305  AAC5 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1306  AAC8 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
1307  AACA ED 79                out (c),a

1428  AB6C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1429  AB6C              ; Paused (main_loop: the pause control, K_PAUSE, BREAK or a Mega Drive pad's
1430  AB6C              ; START by default): PAUSED over the view, white on an opaque black ULA box,
1431  AB6C              ; and under it S: SAVE AND QUIT and X: QUIT, NO SAVE, until the pause control
1432  AB6C              ; is pressed again.  Nothing moves meanwhile and the screen keeps its last
1433  AB6C              ; frame.  S (fixed: only while paused) saves the game (save_game) and goes
1434  AB6C              ; back to the main menu; if it can't be saved, SAVE FAILED, and it stays
1435  AB6C              ; paused.  (Not in a wreck: nothing to save.)  X (fixed too) goes back to
1436  AB6C              ; the main menu without saving: the game is lost, and any save game is left
1437  AB6C              ; as it was.  Needs the input page in slot 7.

1439  AB6C              PAUSE_ROW       equ 7               ; ULA character row and column of the box

1460  AB8E 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR

1462  AB93 CD 57 A1     .w:     call menu_frame
1463  AB96 CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan

1468  ABA2 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
1469  ABA5 20 30                jr nz,.save

1471  ABAA CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed

1474  ABB1 CD CF E0             call key_pressed

1476  ABB6 21 FC AB             ld hl,txt_unpaused              ; the box gone: the view again
1477  ABB9 11 0C 07             ld de,PAUSE_ROW<<8 | PAUSE_COL
1478  ABBC 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR
1479  ABBE CD 0D A1             call menu_print
1480  ABC1 21 2B AC             ld hl,txt_unpaused2
1481  ABC4 11 07 0A             ld de,PAUSE_ROW3<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1482  ABC7 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR

1485  ABCF 11 07 09             ld de,PAUSE_ROW2<<8 | PAUSE_COL2

1489  ABDA 38 06                jr c,.fail

1491  ABDF C3 65 AB             jp menu_go

1493  ABE6 21 18 AC             ld hl,txt_save_fail

1510  AC51              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1511  AC51              ; Save games: ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS (beside the level files), one game.  Written
1512  AC51              ; by save and quit (game_pause: save_game), read by CONTINUE on the main menu
1513  AC51              ; (load_save, continue_game).  "ZPSV", SG_VERSION, then the fields in
1514  AC51              ; sg_fields, in order: the level and wave, the salvage, the VTOL's integrity
1515  AC51              ; (vtol_hp), its weapon slots (type and ammo each) and the selected one, the
1516  AC51              ; store (wpn_stock, wpn_unlocked), the booster (fitted, fuel), and the
1517  AC51              ; vision modes (vision_owned), and the vertical and lateral thrusters
1518  AC51              ; (vthrust_fitted, lthrust_fitted).  Files of an older version (1: before
1519  AC51              ; the vision modes, 2: before the vertical thrusters, 3: before the lateral
1520  AC51              ; ones, 4: before the linked chain guns, a longer store) are refused, as any
1521  AC51              ; other version.
1522  AC51              ; Continued, the level starts afresh at the saved wave: its zombies, the
1523  AC51              ; humans (and this level's rescues so far) and the base are new.
1524  AC51              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1525  AC51              SG_VERSION      equ 5
1526  AC51              sg_fields:      ; address, bytes
1527  AC51 D7 AF                dw level
1528  AC53 01                   db 1
1529  AC54 E0 AF                dw wave_number
1530  AC56 01                   db 1
1531  AC57 E2 AF                dw salvage_points
1532  AC59 02                   db 2
1533  AC5A DA AF                dw vtol_hp
1534  AC5C 01                   db 1
1535  AC5D CA AF                dw wpn_slots
1536  AC5F 0A                   db WPN_SLOTS*2
1537  AC60 D4 AF                dw wpn_sel
1538  AC62 01                   db 1
1539  AC63 52 B0                dw wpn_stock
1540  AC65 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
1541  AC66 5D B0                dw wpn_unlocked
1542  AC68 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
1543  AC69 6D B0                dw boost_fitted                 ; (and boost_fuel, after it)
1544  AC6B 02                   db 2
1545  AC6C 68 B0                dw vision_owned
1546  AC6E 01                   db 1
1547  AC6F 69 B0                dw vthrust_fitted
1548  AC71 01                   db 1
1549  AC72 6A B0                dw lthrust_fitted
1550  AC74 01                   db 1
1551  AC75 00 00                dw 0                            ; (the end)
1552  AC77                      ASSERT boost_fuel == boost_fitted+1
1553  AC77              SG_SIZE         equ 5+1+1+2+1+WPN_SLOTS*2+1+2*(WPN_LAST+1)+2+1+1+1
1554  AC77
1555  AC77              ; Copy the fields: A = 0 the game's into sg_buf, 1 sg_buf's into the game
1556  AC77              sg_copy:
1557  AC77 32 32 AD             ld (sg_dir),a
1558  AC7A DD 21 51 AC          ld ix,sg_fields
1559  AC7E 11 39 AD             ld de,sg_buf+5
1560  AC81 DD 6E 00     .lp:    ld l,(ix+0)
1561  AC84 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1562  AC87 7C                   ld a,h
1563  AC88 B5                   or l
1564  AC89 C8                   ret z
1565  AC8A DD 4E 02             ld c,(ix+2)
1566  AC8D 06 00                ld b,0
1567  AC8F 3A 32 AD             ld a,(sg_dir)
1568  AC92 B7                   or a
1569  AC93 28 06                jr z,.out
1570  AC95 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; into the game: HL = sg_buf
1571  AC96 ED B0                ldir
1572  AC98 EB                   ex de,hl
1573  AC99 18 02                jr .nx
1574  AC9B ED B0        .out:   ldir                            ; out of it: HL = the field
1575  AC9D 01 03 00     .nx:    ld bc,3
1576  ACA0 DD 09                add ix,bc
1577  ACA2 18 DD                jr .lp
1578  ACA4
1579  ACA4              ; Save the game.  Carry set (A = the esxDOS error) if it couldn't be
1580  ACA4              ; written.  Leaves the file handler in slot 7.
1581  ACA4              save_game:

1583  ACA7 11 34 AD             ld de,sg_buf

1586  ACAF 3E 05                ld a,SG_VERSION

1588  ACB2 AF                   xor a
1589  ACB3 CD 77 AC             call sg_copy
1590  ACB6 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
1591  ACBA 21 1A AD             ld hl,sg_name
1592  ACBD 11 34 AD             ld de,sg_buf
1593  ACC0 01 30 00             ld bc,SG_SIZE
1594  ACC3 C3 90 E0             jp fh_save
1595  ACC6
1596  ACC6              ; Read the save game into sg_buf: carry set if there's none, or it isn't a
1597  ACC6              ; save game this version can use (its level out of range too).  Leaves the
1598  ACC6              ; file handler in slot 7.
1599  ACC6              load_save:
1600  ACC6 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
1601  ACCA 21 1A AD             ld hl,sg_name
1602  ACCD 11 34 AD             ld de,sg_buf
1603  ACD0 01 30 00             ld bc,SG_SIZE
1604  ACD3 CD 81 E0             call fh_load
1605  ACD6 D8                   ret c
1606  ACD7 21 D0 FF             ld hl,-SG_SIZE                  ; all of it?
1607  ACDA 09                   add hl,bc
1608  ACDB 7C                   ld a,h
1609  ACDC B5                   or l
1610  ACDD 20 21                jr nz,.bad
1611  ACDF 21 34 AD             ld hl,sg_buf

1613  ACE5 06 04                ld b,4
1614  ACE7 1A           .m:     ld a,(de)
1615  ACE8 BE                   cp (hl)
1616  ACE9 20 15                jr nz,.bad
1617  ACEB 23                   inc hl
1618  ACEC 13                   inc de
1619  ACED 10 F8                djnz .m

1621  ACF0 FE 05                cp SG_VERSION
1622  ACF2 20 0C                jr nz,.bad
1623  ACF4 3A 39 AD             ld a,(sg_buf+5)                 ; its level (sg_fields' first)
1624  ACF7 B7                   or a
1625  ACF8 28 06                jr z,.bad
1626  ACFA FE 33                cp LEVEL_LAST+1
1627  ACFC 30 02                jr nc,.bad
1628  ACFE B7                   or a                            ; usable: carry clear
1629  ACFF C9                   ret
1630  AD00 37           .bad:   scf
1631  AD01 C9                   ret
1632  AD02
1633  AD02              ; CONTINUE (main menu, after load_save): a new game with the save game's
1634  AD02              ; fields over it, into its level at its wave
1635  AD02              continue_game:
1636  AD02 31 F6 B7             ld sp,stack_top
1637  AD05 CD 8A A8             call game_reset
1638  AD08 3E 01                ld a,1

1646  AD1A

1647  AD1E 54 41 2F 53
1647  AD22 41 56 45 47

1649  AD32 00           sg_dir:     db 0

1651  AD34                                                      ; save game's: continue_game)
1652  AD34 00 00 00...  sg_buf:     ds SG_SIZE
1653  AD64
1654  AD64              ; Z if the VTOL is landed: speed 0 and resting on the floor under it (the
1655  AD64              ; road, the landing pad or a roof: floor_y), and not a wreck.  Landed, its
1656  AD64              ; weapons don't fire (update_weapons) and humans can board or get off
1657  AD64              ; (human_update).
1658  AD64              vtol_landed:
1659  AD64 3A DB AF             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1660  AD67 B7                   or a
1661  AD68 C0                   ret nz                          ; a wreck

1664  AD6D C0                   ret nz                          ; moving
1665  AD6E                      ; fall through
1666  AD6E
1667  AD6E              ; Z if the VTOL rests on the floor under it (floor_y), at any speed: on the
1668  AD6E              ; ground, or a roof or the pad (update_player then brakes it to a stop)
1669  AD6E              vtol_on_floor:
1670  AD6E CD 09 AB             call floor_y
1671  AD71 ED 5B C3 AF          ld de,(cam_y)
1672  AD75 B7                   or a
1673  AD76 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; Z: resting on it
1674  AD78 C9                   ret
1675  AD79
1676  AD79              ; The VTOL's footprint: the corners and the long-side midpoints of its
1677  AD79              ; VTOL_HL x VTOL_HW (half size) rectangle, turned to the heading, round
1678  AD79              ; (cam_x, cam_z).  The rectangle is smaller than a tile, so these six points
1679  AD79              ; find every cell it overlaps (to within a tile corner nicking a long side).
1680  AD79              ; HL = vg_max = the highest ground under them; Z if all road (0).
1681  AD79              vtol_ground:
1682  AD79 3A C6 AF             ld a,(yaw)                      ; forward (sin, cos), right (cos, -sin)
1683  AD7C CD CD AE             call get_sin
1684  AD7F 22 71 B0             ld (vg_sin),hl
1685  AD82 3A C6 AF             ld a,(yaw)
1686  AD85 C6 40                add a,64
1687  AD87 CD CD AE             call get_sin
1688  AD8A 22 73 B0             ld (vg_cos),hl
1689  AD8D EB                   ex de,hl
1690  AD8E 21 40 00             ld hl,VTOL_HL
1691  AD91 CD 84 AF             call fmul
1692  AD94 22 77 B0             ld (vg_fz),hl                   ; nose offset z = HL cos
1693  AD97 ED 5B 73 B0          ld de,(vg_cos)
1694  AD9B 21 13 00             ld hl,VTOL_HW
1695  AD9E CD 84 AF             call fmul
1696  ADA1 22 79 B0             ld (vg_rx),hl                   ; side offset x = HW cos
1697  ADA4 ED 5B 71 B0          ld de,(vg_sin)
1698  ADA8 21 40 00             ld hl,VTOL_HL
1699  ADAB CD 84 AF             call fmul
1700  ADAE 22 75 B0             ld (vg_fx),hl                   ; nose offset x = HL sin
1701  ADB1 ED 5B 71 B0          ld de,(vg_sin)
1702  ADB5 21 13 00             ld hl,VTOL_HW
1703  ADB8 CD 84 AF             call fmul
1704  ADBB CD 78 AF             call neg_hl

1755  AE24                      ROWOFS

1755  AE25 29          >        add hl,hl
1755  AE26 29          >        add hl,hl
1755  AE27 29          >        add hl,hl
1755  AE28 29          >        add hl,hl
1755  AE29 29          >        add hl,hl

1764  AE3B B7                   or a
1765  AE3C ED 52                sbc hl,de
1766  AE3E D8                   ret c                           ; lower than the highest so far
1767  AE3F 19                   add hl,de
1768  AE40 22 7D B0             ld (vg_max),hl
1769  AE43 C9                   ret

1814  AE95

1828  AEB2

1833  AEBE

1836  AEC3 21 00 A0             ld hl,hztab
