1838  AEC8 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1839  AEC9 32 C9 B6             ld (horizon),a
1840  AECC C9                   ret
1841  AECD
1842  AECD              ; A = angle -> HL = sin (S7.8).  Pages the sine table into slot 0 (PAGE_SIN):
1843  AECD              ; call it only outside the Layer 2 drawing (it is: setup_frame, the player,
1844  AECD              ; vtol_ground), never between a section's paging and its writes.
1845  AECD              get_sin:
1846  AECD ED 91 50 0E          nextreg SIN_MMU,PAGE_SIN        ; the table at $0000 (slot 0)
1847  AED1 6F                   ld l,a
1848  AED2 26 00                ld h,high sin_lo
1849  AED4 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1850  AED5 24                   inc h
1851  AED6 66                   ld h,(hl)
1852  AED7 6F                   ld l,a
1853  AED8 C9                   ret
1854  AED9
1855  AED9              ; Rotate the building edge vectors (s,0,0) and (0,0,s) into camera space.
1856  AED9              ; HL = s, IX -> 16 bytes: VX(X,Y,Z) VZ(X,Y,Z) corner offset (X,Z1)
1857  AED9              make_vecs:
1858  AED9 22 E8 B6             ld (mv_s),hl
1859  AEDC ED 5B CC B6          ld de,(cos_y)
1860  AEE0 CD 84 AF             call fmul
1861  AEE3 22 EA B6             ld (mv_c),hl                    ; s*cosY
1862  AEE6 2A E8 B6             ld hl,(mv_s)
1863  AEE9 ED 5B CA B6          ld de,(sin_y)
1864  AEED CD 84 AF             call fmul
1865  AEF0 22 EC B6             ld (mv_n),hl                    ; s*sinY
1866  AEF3                      ; VX = ( s cosY, -s sinY sinP, s sinY cosP )
1867  AEF3 2A EA B6             ld hl,(mv_c)
1868  AEF6 DD 75 00             ld (ix+0),l
1869  AEF9 DD 74 01             ld (ix+1),h
1870  AEFC 2A EC B6             ld hl,(mv_n)
1871  AEFF ED 5B CE B6          ld de,(sin_p)
1872  AF03 CD 84 AF             call fmul
1873  AF06 CD 78 AF             call neg_hl

1875  AF0C DD 74 03             ld (ix+3),h
1876  AF0F 2A EC B6             ld hl,(mv_n)
1877  AF12 ED 5B D0 B6          ld de,(cos_p)
1878  AF16 CD 84 AF             call fmul
1879  AF19 DD 75 04             ld (ix+4),l
1880  AF1C DD 74 05             ld (ix+5),h
1881  AF1F                      ; VZ = ( -s sinY, -s cosY sinP, s cosY cosP )
1882  AF1F 2A EC B6             ld hl,(mv_n)
1883  AF22 CD 78 AF             call neg_hl
1884  AF25 DD 75 06             ld (ix+6),l
1885  AF28 DD 74 07             ld (ix+7),h
1886  AF2B 2A EA B6             ld hl,(mv_c)
1887  AF2E ED 5B CE B6          ld de,(sin_p)
1888  AF32 CD 84 AF             call fmul
1889  AF35 CD 78 AF             call neg_hl
1890  AF38 DD 75 08             ld (ix+8),l
1891  AF3B DD 74 09             ld (ix+9),h
1892  AF3E 2A EA B6             ld hl,(mv_c)
1893  AF41 ED 5B D0 B6          ld de,(cos_p)
1894  AF45 CD 84 AF             call fmul
1895  AF48 DD 75 0A             ld (ix+10),l
1896  AF4B DD 74 0B             ld (ix+11),h
1897  AF4E                      ; cell centre -> footprint corner (-s/2,-s/2) in yaw space
1898  AF4E 2A EC B6             ld hl,(mv_n)
1899  AF51 ED 5B EA B6          ld de,(mv_c)
1900  AF55 B7                   or a
1901  AF56 ED 52                sbc hl,de
1902  AF58 CB 2C                sra h
1903  AF5A CB 1D                rr l
1904  AF5C DD 75 0C             ld (ix+12),l                    ; X: s/2 (sinY - cosY)
1905  AF5F DD 74 0D             ld (ix+13),h
1906  AF62 2A EC B6             ld hl,(mv_n)
1907  AF65 ED 5B EA B6          ld de,(mv_c)
1908  AF69 19                   add hl,de
1909  AF6A CB 2C                sra h
1910  AF6C CB 1D                rr l
1911  AF6E CD 78 AF             call neg_hl
1912  AF71 DD 75 0E             ld (ix+14),l                    ; Z1: -s/2 (sinY + cosY)
1913  AF74 DD 74 0F             ld (ix+15),h
1914  AF77 C9                   ret
1915  AF78
1916  AF78              ;==============================================================================
1917  AF78              ; Fixed point maths
1918  AF78              ;==============================================================================
1919  AF78
1920  AF78              ; HL = -HL
1921  AF78              neg_hl:
1922  AF78 AF                   xor a
1923  AF79 95                   sub l
1924  AF7A 6F                   ld l,a
1925  AF7B 9F                   sbc a,a
1926  AF7C 94                   sub h
1927  AF7D 67                   ld h,a
1928  AF7E C9                   ret
1929  AF7F
1930  AF7F              ; HL = |HL|
1931  AF7F              abs_hl:
1932  AF7F CB 7C                bit 7,h
1933  AF81 C8                   ret z
1934  AF82 18 F4                jr neg_hl
1935  AF84
1936  AF84              ; fmul: HL = HL * DE >> 8
1937  AF84              ;   HL = signed 16-bit integer, DE = S7.8 factor in -1.0..+1.0
1938  AF84              ;   Sign/magnitude using two 8x8 MUL D,E.  Preserves IX, IY.
1939  AF84              fmul:
1940  AF84 7C                   ld a,h
1941  AF85 AA                   xor d
1942  AF86 F5                   push af                         ; result sign in bit 7
1943  AF87 CB 7C                bit 7,h
1944  AF89 28 06                jr z,.ap
1945  AF8B AF                   xor a
1946  AF8C 95                   sub l
1947  AF8D 6F                   ld l,a
1948  AF8E 9F                   sbc a,a
1949  AF8F 94                   sub h
1950  AF90 67                   ld h,a
1951  AF91 CB 7A        .ap:    bit 7,d
1952  AF93 28 06                jr z,.bp
1953  AF95 AF                   xor a
1954  AF96 93                   sub e
1955  AF97 5F                   ld e,a
1956  AF98 9F                   sbc a,a
1957  AF99 92                   sub d
1958  AF9A 57                   ld d,a
1959  AF9B 7A           .bp:    ld a,d
1960  AF9C B7                   or a
1961  AF9D 20 10                jr nz,.one                      ; |factor| == 1.0
1962  AF9F 7B                   ld a,e
1963  AFA0 55                   ld d,l
1964  AFA1 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; lo * f
1965  AFA3 4A                   ld c,d
1966  AFA4 54                   ld d,h
1967  AFA5 5F                   ld e,a
1968  AFA6 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; hi * f
1969  AFA8 7B                   ld a,e
1970  AFA9 81                   add a,c
1971  AFAA 6F                   ld l,a
1972  AFAB 7A                   ld a,d
1973  AFAC CE 00                adc a,0
1974  AFAE 67                   ld h,a
1975  AFAF F1           .one:   pop af
1976  AFB0 F0                   ret p
1977  AFB1 AF                   xor a
1978  AFB2 95                   sub l
1979  AFB3 6F                   ld l,a
1980  AFB4 9F                   sbc a,a
1981  AFB5 94                   sub h
1982  AFB6 67                   ld h,a
1983  AFB7 C9                   ret
1984  AFB8
1985  AFB8              ; HL = 0.5 * HL (signed): the top/bottom frustum slope, VIEW_CY/128
1986  AFB8              zhalf:
1987  AFB8 CB 2C                sra h
1988  AFBA CB 1D                rr l
1989  AFBC C9                   ret

 173+ E883              ; IX = (HL << 16) / DE   with HL < DE (unsigned) -> 0.16 fraction
 174+ E883              ; Restoring division, unrolled: each quotient bit goes in inverted, as the
 175+ E883              ; carry (set: the divisor didn't fit), 8 into A, which is complemented:
 176+ E883              ; the high byte, then the low.  Keeps BC.
 177+ E883                  MACRO DIVBIT q
 178+ E883 ~                    add hl,hl
 179+ E883 ~                    jr c,$+9                        ; (17-bit remainder: it fits)
 180+ E883 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; (carry clear)
 181+ E883 ~                    jr nc,$+9                       ; fits: bit 1 (carry clear)
 182+ E883 ~                    add hl,de                       ; doesn't: put it back (carry set)
 183+ E883 ~                    jr $+6
 184+ E883 ~                    or a                            ; (from the jr c)
 185+ E883 ~                    sbc hl,de
 186+ E883 ~                    or a                            ; bit 1
 187+ E883 ~                    q                               ; (all the jumps land here)
 188+ E883                  ENDM

 248+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 249+ E937              ; Perspective projection
 250+ E937              ;   in : HL -> X,Y,Z (camera space, inside the view frustum, Z > 0)
 251+ E937              ;   out: A = screen x (0..255), C = screen y (0..VIEW_H-1)
 252+ E937              ;   sx = 128 + 128*X/Z,  sy = 64 - 128*Y/Z   (90 x 53 degree field of view)
 253+ E937              ;   Z is normalised to 9 bits (256..511) with a barrel shift (count from a
 254+ E937              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied
 255+ E937              ;   by a 16-bit reciprocal from rtab.  |X| <= Z keeps Xn within 9 bits.
 256+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 257+ E937              project:

 369+ E9D4
 370+ E9D4                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 371+ E9D4              ;==============================================================================
 372+ E9D4              ; 2D clip of the current face (df_ptr, df_mask), no corner behind the near
 373+ E9D4              ; plane.  Carry set: a corner is outside the guard band (nothing drawn, clip
 374+ E9D4              ; it in 3D).  Else p2buf / p2n hold the clipped polygon (p2n < 3: none).
 375+ E9D4              ; The corners go into clipA as x, y (16-bit screen), pad, edge flag (+6),
 376+ E9D4              ; pad, and are clipped by clip_poly with clip_plane = $80: plane_dist and

 485+ EA99              ; IX -> corner (X, Y, Z; Z >= NEAR) -> its screen x, y (16-bit) at IY+0, +2,
 486+ EA99              ; the screen planes it is outside ORed into c2_or.  Carry set (nothing
 487+ EA99              ; stored) if outside the guard band |X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z.
 488+ EA99              guard_proj:

 534+ EAFB
 535+ EAFB              ; HL = component, DE = the screen centre, B = the upper bound, C = the lower
 536+ EAFB              ; plane's c2_or bit (the upper's is the next) -> HL = DE + 128 HL / Z (the
 537+ EAFB              ; Z patched in by zpatch), and the plane it is outside, if any, into c2_or
 538+ EAFB              c2_scr:
 539+ EAFB C5                   push bc
 540+ EAFC D5                   push de

 542+ EAFE F5                   push af

 544+ EB02 F1                   pop af
 545+ EB03 17                   rla
 546+ EB04 DC 78 AF             call c,neg_hl

 548+ EB08 19                   add hl,de

 563+ EB20
 564+ EB20              ; HL = signed component -> HL = round(|HL| * 128 / Z), |HL| <= 2Z: as
 565+ EB20              ; scale_comp (the same shift and reciprocal, patched into it by zpatch),
 566+ EB20              ; with a 10-bit Xn and a 16-bit result
 567+ EB20              scomp16:

 569+ EB23 EB                   ex de,hl

 609+ EB66 20 01                jr nz,.nr

 611+ EB69 6C           .nr:    ld l,h
 612+ EB6A 61                   ld h,c
 613+ EB6B CB 3C                srl h
 614+ EB6D CB 1D                rr l                            ; HL = (C:H) >> 1 = P >> 9
 615+ EB6F C9                   ret
 616+ EB70
 617+ EB70              ; clip_isect for a 2D plane: the point where the edge S-E crosses it, out
 618+ EB70              ; at IY (IY and clip_on advanced).  Worked out from the edge's inside end,
 619+ EB70              ; so an edge two faces share is cut at the same point whichever way it
 620+ EB70              ; runs: t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|), the other coordinate o_in + t (o_out -
 621+ EB70              ; o_in), this one exactly on the bound.
 622+ EB70              c2_isect:
 623+ EB70 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 624+ EB73 ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 625+ EB77 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)

 627+ EB7B 30 01                jr nc,.sin

 629+ EB7E 3A DC E0     .sin:   ld a,(c2_off)
 630+ EB81 EE 02                xor 2                           ; the other coordinate
 631+ EB83 ED 31                add hl,a
 632+ EB85 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 633+ EB86 23                   inc hl
 634+ EB87 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; o_in
 635+ EB88 EB                   ex de,hl
 636+ EB89 ED 31                add hl,a
 637+ EB8B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 638+ EB8C 23                   inc hl
 639+ EB8D 66                   ld h,(hl)
 640+ EB8E 6F                   ld l,a                          ; o_out
 641+ EB8F B7                   or a
 642+ EB90 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; o_out - o_in
 643+ EB92 28 26                jr z,.same                      ; (a vertical / horizontal edge: o_in)
 644+ EB94 C5                   push bc
 645+ EB95 E5                   push hl
 646+ EB96 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 647+ EB99 CD 7F AF             call abs_hl
 648+ EB9C EB                   ex de,hl

 674+ EBD6 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h

 676+ EBDC FD 77 02             ld (iy+2),a
 677+ EBDF FD 36 03 00          ld (iy+3),0

 679+ EBE6                  ENDIF
 680+ EBE6
 681+ EBE6              ; HL = signed component -> A = round(|HL| * 128 / Z)
 682+ EBE6              ; The shift and reciprocal for this Z are patched in by zpatch: the shift
 683+ EBE6              ; as a barrel shift whose count and direction (its opcode, BSRL or BSLA)
 684+ EBE6              ; are both patched, so it runs straight through (a right shift by 0 for a Z
 685+ EBE6              ; already 256..511 leaves it as it is).
 686+ EBE6              scale_comp:
 687+ EBE6 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 688+ EBE8 28 06                jr z,.ap

 698+ EBF5 EB                   ex de,hl

 704+ EBFC 55                   ld d,l

 709+ EC03 1E 00        .rh:    ld e,0

 713+ EC09 6F                   ld l,a

 731+ EC22 21 FF 01     .big:   ld hl,511                       ; clamp (rounding at frustum edge)
 732+ EC25 18 D4                jr .ok

 734+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 735+ EC27              ; Outcode: HL -> vertex (X,Y,Z) -> A = bits
 736+ EC27              ;   1 near (Z<NEAR)  2 left (X<-Z)  4 right (X>Z)
 737+ EC27              ;   8 top (Y>0.5Z)   16 bottom (Y<-0.5Z)
 738+ EC27              ;==============================================================================

 853+ ECCA              ;==============================================================================
 854+ ECCA              ; Sutherland-Hodgman clip of clip_src (clip_n verts) against clip_plane into
 855+ ECCA              ; clip_dst.  Vertex = X,Y,Z,flag,corner (8 bytes).  flag=1 means the edge from
 856+ ECCA              ; this vertex to the next is a real building edge (gets outlined); edges
 857+ ECCA              ; created along a clip plane get flag=0 so the screen border isn't outlined.
 858+ ECCA              ; corner = vtx offset of an unclipped building corner that is on screen, so
 859+ ECCA              ; its cached projection can be reused; $80 + plane bit for a vertex the
 860+ ECCA              ; clipper put on that plane; $FF for any other vertex.

1276+ F049
1277+ F049              ;==============================================================================
1278+ F049              ; Convex polygon fill from p2buf (8-bit screen coords).
1279+ F049              ;   Each edge is walked with an exact integer DDA into one of two x tables:
1280+ F049              ;   downward edges -> TA, upward edges -> TB.  For a convex polygon every row
1281+ F049              ;   then has one entry in each, and the span between them is filled.
1282+ F049              ;   Winding doesn't matter.
1283+ F049              ;==============================================================================
1284+ F049              fill_poly:
1285+ F049 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1286+ F04C 47                   ld b,a
1287+ F04D 21 81 E0             ld hl,p2buf+1
1288+ F050 0E FF                ld c,255
1289+ F052 16 00                ld d,0
1290+ F054 7E           .mm:    ld a,(hl)
1291+ F055 B9                   cp c
1292+ F056 30 01                jr nc,.m1
1293+ F058 4F                   ld c,a
1294+ F059 BA           .m1:    cp d
1295+ F05A 38 01                jr c,.m2
1296+ F05C 57                   ld d,a
1297+ F05D 23           .m2:    inc hl
1298+ F05E 23                   inc hl
1299+ F05F 23                   inc hl
1300+ F060 23                   inc hl
1301+ F061 10 F1                djnz .mm
1302+ F063 79                   ld a,c
1303+ F064 BA                   cp d
1304+ F065 C8                   ret z                           ; zero height - outline only
1305+ F066 32 E9 E0             ld (fy0),a

1307+ F06C BE                   cp (hl)                         ; nearer buildings, drawn after this
1308+ F06D D0                   ret nc                          ; one (occlusion): none to fill

1310+ F06F 3D                   dec a
1311+ F070 BA                   cp d
1312+ F071 38 01                jr c,.cut                       ; the last row to fill: the lower of
1313+ F073 7A                   ld a,d                          ; the face's and bld_cut-1
1314+ F074 32 EA E0     .cut:   ld (fy1),a
1315+ F077
1316+ F077 DD 21 80 E0          ld ix,p2buf
1317+ F07B 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1318+ F07E 32 EB E0             ld (fe_cnt),a
1319+ F081 DD 56 00     .ed:    ld d,(ix+0)
1320+ F084 DD 5E 01             ld e,(ix+1)

1322+ F08A DD 4E 05             ld c,(ix+5)

1328+ F094 50                   ld d,b
1329+ F095 47                   ld b,a

1336+ F09F DD E5        .walk:  push ix
1337+ F0A1 CD BC F0             call walk_edge
1338+ F0A4 DD E1                pop ix
1339+ F0A6 01 04 00     .nx:    ld bc,4
1340+ F0A9 DD 09                add ix,bc

1347+ F0B7 57                   ld d,a
1348+ F0B8 5F                   ld e,a                          ; PUSH pair for short spans
1349+ F0B9 C3 4A F1             jp fill_spans
1350+ F0BC
1351+ F0BC              ; Walk an edge (D=xa, E=ya) -> (B=xb, C=yb), yb > ya, into table page A.
1352+ F0BC              ; Bresenham style: x += q each row, fractional r/dy accumulated in a biased
1353+ F0BC              ; byte (carry == wrap), so the end point is hit exactly.
1354+ F0BC              walk_edge:
1355+ F0BC 67                   ld h,a
1356+ F0BD 6B                   ld l,e
1357+ F0BE 79                   ld a,c
1358+ F0BF 93                   sub e
1359+ F0C0 4F                   ld c,a                          ; C = dy (1..191)
1360+ F0C1 78                   ld a,b
1361+ F0C2 92                   sub d                           ; dx

1363+ F0C5 38 37                jr c,.neg
1364+ F0C7 B9                   cp c
1365+ F0C8 30 07                jr nc,.pdv
1366+ F0CA DD 6F                ld ixl,a                        ; steep: q = 0, r = dx
1367+ F0CC CD 3E F1             call .setup
1368+ F0CF 18 20                jr .p0s
1369+ F0D1 CD 0B E9     .pdv:   call div8                       ; E = q, A = r
1370+ F0D4 DD 63                ld ixh,e
1371+ F0D6 DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1372+ F0D8 CD 3E F1             call .setup

1374+ F0DD B7                   or a
1375+ F0DE 28 11                jr z,.p0s
1376+ F0E0 72           .pl:    ld (hl),d
1377+ F0E1 2C                   inc l
1378+ F0E2 7A                   ld a,d
1379+ F0E3 DD 84                add a,ixh
1380+ F0E5 57                   ld d,a
1381+ F0E6 7B                   ld a,e
1382+ F0E7 DD 85                add a,ixl
1383+ F0E9 30 02                jr nc,.pl1
1384+ F0EB 81                   add a,c
1385+ F0EC 14                   inc d
1386+ F0ED 5F           .pl1:   ld e,a
1387+ F0EE 10 F0                djnz .pl
1388+ F0F0 C9                   ret
1389+ F0F1              ; (no x step: the accumulator kept in A and the remainder in E, not IXL)
1390+ F0F1 7B           .p0s:   ld a,e
1391+ F0F2 DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1392+ F0F4 72           .p0:    ld (hl),d

1394+ F0F6 83                   add a,e

1397+ F0FA 14                   inc d
1398+ F0FB 10 F7        .p01:   djnz .p0
1399+ F0FD C9                   ret
1400+ F0FE

1402+ F100 B9                   cp c
1403+ F101 30 07                jr nc,.ndv
1404+ F103 DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1405+ F105 CD 3E F1             call .setup
1406+ F108 18 20                jr .n0s
1407+ F10A CD 0B E9     .ndv:   call div8
1408+ F10D DD 63                ld ixh,e
1409+ F10F DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1410+ F111 CD 3E F1             call .setup
1411+ F114 DD 7C                ld a,ixh
1412+ F116 B7                   or a
1413+ F117 28 11                jr z,.n0s
1414+ F119 72           .nl:    ld (hl),d
1415+ F11A 2C                   inc l
1416+ F11B 7A                   ld a,d
1417+ F11C DD 94                sub ixh
1418+ F11E 57                   ld d,a
1419+ F11F 7B                   ld a,e
1420+ F120 DD 85                add a,ixl
1421+ F122 30 02                jr nc,.nl1

1423+ F125 15                   dec d
1424+ F126 5F           .nl1:   ld e,a
1425+ F127 10 F0                djnz .nl
1426+ F129 C9                   ret

1428+ F12B DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1429+ F12D 72           .n0:    ld (hl),d
1430+ F12E 2C                   inc l
1431+ F12F 83                   add a,e
1432+ F130 30 02                jr nc,.n01
1433+ F132 81                   add a,c
1434+ F133 15                   dec d
1435+ F134 10 F7        .n01:   djnz .n0
1436+ F136 C9                   ret
1437+ F137
1438+ F137              ; A vertical edge: the same x on every row (as the steep walk gives it with
1439+ F137              ; no x step: exactly)
1440+ F137 41           .vert:  ld b,c
1441+ F138 04                   inc b                           ; dy+1 rows
1442+ F139 72           .vl:    ld (hl),d
1443+ F13A 2C                   inc l
1444+ F13B 10 FC                djnz .vl
1445+ F13D C9                   ret
1446+ F13E
1447+ F13E              ; B = dy+1 rows, E = biased accumulator (dy/2 - dy), C = -dy
1448+ F13E 41           .setup: ld b,c
1449+ F13F 04                   inc b
1450+ F140 79                   ld a,c
1451+ F141 CB 3F                srl a
1452+ F143 91                   sub c
1453+ F144 5F                   ld e,a
1454+ F145 79                   ld a,c
1455+ F146 ED 44                neg
1456+ F148 4F                   ld c,a
1457+ F149 C9                   ret
1458+ F14A
1459+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1460+ F14A              ; Span filler.  Rows fy0..fy1, x from TA/TB.  DE = colour pair.
1461+ F14A              ; Short spans use the stack pointer as a 2-byte write pointer into the frame
1462+ F14A              ; buffer (see push_blk), jumping into an unrolled block of PUSH DE.  Spans of
1463+ F14A              ; DMA_SPAN_MIN pixels or more are written by the zxnDMA, which only needs its
1464+ F14A              ; length and destination reloaded (see clear_screen).
1465+ F14A              ; For speed: the stack pointer is kept in IY (ld sp,iy), the rows are
1466+ F14A              ; counted down in IXH, and the table that is the left edge at the polygon's
1467+ F14A              ; middle row is read first, so the left / right swap (still made whenever
1468+ F14A              ; it's needed: a sliver's edges can cross) is mostly skipped.
1469+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1470+ F14A              fill_spans:
1471+ F14A 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1472+ F14D CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; first row's section into slot 0
1473+ F150 FD 21 00 00          ld iy,0
1474+ F154 FD 39                add iy,sp                       ; the stack, for push_end
1475+ F156 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1476+ F159 47                   ld b,a
1477+ F15A 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)
1478+ F15D 90                   sub b
1479+ F15E 3C                   inc a
1480+ F15F DD 67                ld ixh,a                        ; rows to fill
1481+ F161 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)                      ; the middle row: which table is left?
1482+ F164 80                   add a,b
1483+ F165 1F                   rra
1484+ F166 6F                   ld l,a
1485+ F167 26 E2                ld h,high TA
1486+ F169 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1487+ F16A 24                   inc h
1488+ F16B BE                   cp (hl)
1489+ F16C 3E E2                ld a,high TA                    ; TA left (or level): TA first
1490+ F16E 0E 24                ld c,$24                        ;   (inc h)
1491+ F170 38 04                jr c,.ta
1492+ F172 3E E3                ld a,high TB                    ; TB left: TB first
1493+ F174 0E 25                ld c,$25                        ;   (dec h)
1494+ F176 32 7E F1     .ta:    ld (fs_loop+1),a
1495+ F179 79                   ld a,c
1496+ F17A 32 81 F1             ld (fs_loop.tb),a
1497+ F17D
1498+ F17D              fs_loop:
1499+ F17D 26 E2                ld h,high TA                    ; (patched: the left table first)
1500+ F17F 68                   ld l,b
1501+ F180 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1502+ F181 24           .tb:    inc h                           ; (patched: inc h, or dec h, the other)
1503+ F182 4E                   ld c,(hl)
1504+ F183 B9                   cp c
1505+ F184 38 03                jr c,.ord
1506+ F186 69                   ld l,c
1507+ F187 4F                   ld c,a
1508+ F188 7D                   ld a,l
1509+ F189 6F           .ord:   ld l,a                          ; A = left x, C = right x
1510+ F18A 78                   ld a,b
1511+ F18B E6 1F                and 31
1512+ F18D 67                   ld h,a                          ; row within the paged section
1513+ F18E 79                   ld a,c
1514+ F18F 95                   sub l                           ; width-1
1515+ F190 FE 13                cp DMA_SPAN_MIN-1
1516+ F192 30 17                jr nc,.dma
1517+ F194 CB 3F        .push:  srl a
1518+ F196 38 07                jr c,.even
1519+ F198 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; odd width: single pixel first
1520+ F199 B7                   or a
1521+ F19A CA 84 E1             jp z,push_next                  ; (1 pixel: no PUSHes, so SP isn't
1522+ F19D 18 01                jr .go                          ; borrowed: see push_blk)
1523+ F19F 3C           .even:  inc a
1524+ F1A0 69           .go:    ld l,c
1525+ F1A1 23                   inc hl                          ; one past right edge (may be $C000)
1526+ F1A2 F9                   ld sp,hl
1527+ F1A3 6F                   ld l,a
1528+ F1A4 3E 80                ld a,low push_end - 1           ; (the DI before the last PUSH)
1529+ F1A6 95                   sub l
1530+ F1A7 6F                   ld l,a
1531+ F1A8 26 E1                ld h,high push_end
1532+ F1AA E9                   jp (hl)
1533+ F1AB                      ASSERT high push_blk == high push_end && low push_end - 1 - 128 == low push_blk
1534+ F1AB
1535+ F1AB                      ; Long span: zxnDMA from the fixed colour byte (port A) to HL.
1536+ F1AB                      ; Everything but length and destination was set up by clear_screen.
1537+ F1AB 3C           .dma:   inc a
1538+ F1AC 20 03                jr nz,.dmal
1539+ F1AE 3D                   dec a                           ; 256 wide: length needs the high
1540+ F1AF 18 E3                jr .push                        ; byte, so PUSH it (A = width-1)
1541+ F1B1              .dmal:
1542+ F1B1 4F                   ld c,a
1543+ F1B2 3E 25                ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_LO
1544+ F1B4 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1545+ F1B6 79                   ld a,c
1546+ F1B7 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; length = width
1547+ F1B9 3E AD                ld a,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
1548+ F1BB D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1549+ F1BD 7D                   ld a,l
1550+ F1BE D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; port B = y*256 + x
1551+ F1C0 7C                   ld a,h
1552+ F1C1 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1553+ F1C3 3E CF                ld a,DMA_LOAD
1554+ F1C5 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1555+ F1C7 3E 87                ld a,DMA_ENABLE
1556+ F1C9 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; CPU waits until the span is written
1557+ F1CB 04                   inc b                           ; the next row (as push_next: SP was
1558+ F1CC DD 25                dec ixh                         ; never borrowed here)
1559+ F1CE C8                   ret z
1560+ F1CF 78                   ld a,b
1561+ F1D0 E6 1F                and 31
1562+ F1D2 C2 7D F1             jp nz,fs_loop
1563+ F1D5 C3 8E E1             jp push_next.sect
1564+ F1D8                      ASSERT high TB == high TA + 1
1565+ F1D8
1566+ F1D8              ;==============================================================================
1567+ F1D8              ; Outline the polygon in p2buf, skipping edges flagged 0 (clip edges)
1568+ F1D8              ;==============================================================================
1569+ F1D8              outline_poly:
1570+ F1D8 DD 21 80 E0          ld ix,p2buf
1571+ F1DC 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1572+ F1DF 47                   ld b,a
1573+ F1E0 C5           .lp:    push bc
1574+ F1E1 DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
1575+ F1E4 B7                   or a
1576+ F1E5 28 0F                jr z,.sk
1577+ F1E7 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
1578+ F1EA DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1579+ F1ED DD 5E 04             ld e,(ix+4)
1580+ F1F0 DD 56 05             ld d,(ix+5)
1581+ F1F3 CD FF F1             call draw_line
1582+ F1F6 01 04 00     .sk:    ld bc,4
1583+ F1F9 DD 09                add ix,bc
1584+ F1FB C1                   pop bc
1585+ F1FC 10 E2                djnz .lp
1586+ F1FE C9                   ret
1587+ F1FF
1588+ F1FF              ;==============================================================================
1589+ F1FF              ; Bresenham line, on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
1590+ F1FF              ;   L = x0, H = y0, E = x1, D = y1, colour in line_col.  Preserves IX, IY.
1591+ F1FF              ;   Pages Layer 2 sections into slot 0 as the line crosses them.
1592+ F1FF              ;==============================================================================
1593+ F1FF              draw_line:
1594+ F1FF 3A EC E0             ld a,(line_col)
1595+ F202 4F                   ld c,a
1596+ F203 7B                   ld a,e
1597+ F204 95                   sub l
1598+ F205 30 06                jr nc,.xp
1599+ F207 ED 44                neg
1600+ F209 06 2D                ld b,OP_DEC_L
1601+ F20B 18 02                jr .xd
1602+ F20D 06 2C        .xp:    ld b,OP_INC_L
1603+ F20F 5F           .xd:    ld e,a                          ; |dx|
1604+ F210 78                   ld a,b
1605+ F211 32 39 F2             ld (.smx1),a
1606+ F214 32 56 F2             ld (.smx2),a
1607+ F217 7A                   ld a,d
1608+ F218 94                   sub h

1653+ F25B              ; Clear the viewport (rows 0..VIEW_H-1) of the back buffer with the zxnDMA,
1654+ F25B              ; one 8K section (32 rows) at a time through slot 0: sky above the horizon

1669+ F265                  ENDIF

1718+ F2AA              ;==============================================================================
1719+ F2AA              ; City traversal - back to front without sorting.
1720+ F2AA              ;   For grid-aligned boxes in separate cells, a box can only hide boxes whose
1721+ F2AA              ;   cell offsets from the camera cell are larger (or equal) on both axes in
1722+ F2AA              ;   the same quadrant.  So: rows from the far edges inwards, and within each
1723+ F2AA              ;   row columns from the far edges inwards, the camera row/column last.
1724+ F2AA              ;==============================================================================

1741+ F2CC                  ENDIF

1768+ F304              ; The cell walks (draw_row here, occ_row in city2.asm) keep the cell's
1769+ F304              ; yaw-space centre (X, Z1) in the alternate registers HL', DE' (nothing else
1770+ F304              ; uses the alternate set, the interrupt routine included), and step it one
1771+ F304              ; cell at a time by (cosY, sinY), patched into the steps each frame

1832+ F3D9
1833+ F3D9              ; The rows the cell walks can skip this frame: row_skip[j - cz + view_r] not
1834+ F3D9              ; 0 if every cell in row j would be skipped by WALK_TRY.  Its tests are
1835+ F3D9              ; linear along a row (X and Z1 are), so a row is out if both its end cells
1836+ F3D9              ; (cx -/+ view_r, the walk's starts) are past the same edge: right, X - Z1 >=
1837+ F3D9              ; WALK_R; left, -X - Z1 >= WALK_R; behind, -Z1 >= WALK_R (pitched: only
1838+ F3D9              ; behind, as WALK_TRY).  So the camera column's cell, which the walks try
1839+ F3D9              ; without WALK_TRY, is out too.  X = dx cosY - dz sinY, Z1 = dx sinY + dz
1840+ F3D9              ; cosY, by fmul as row_start's rot_yaw, the dz terms stepped by sinY and
1841+ F3D9              ; cosY a row (fmul(256, f) is f exactly); ROW_M covers the rounding (each
1842+ F3D9              ; of these and the walk's own within 2).
1843+ F3D9              ROW_M           equ 8
1844+ F3D9              row_cull:

1974+ F4EE 11 02 FC             ld de,rc_m
1975+ F4F1 CD 0A F5             call rc_min                     ; right: p - q
1976+ F4F4 D1                   pop de

1978+ F4F6 2A 14 FC             ld hl,(rc_s)
1979+ F4F9 19                   add hl,de
1980+ F4FA CD 78 AF             call neg_hl
1981+ F4FD 11 04 FC             ld de,rc_m+2
1982+ F500 CD 0A F5             call rc_min                     ; left: -(p + q)
1983+ F503 E1                   pop hl
1984+ F504 CD 78 AF             call neg_hl
1985+ F507 11 06 FC             ld de,rc_m+4
1986+ F50A                                                      ; behind: -q
1987+ F50A              ; HL = v, DE -> a word: the word = min(word, v), signed (|v| < 16384)
1988+ F50A              rc_min:
1989+ F50A E5                   push hl
1990+ F50B EB                   ex de,hl
1991+ F50C 5E                   ld e,(hl)
1992+ F50D 23                   inc hl
1993+ F50E 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE = the word, HL -> its high byte
1994+ F50F E3                   ex (sp),hl                      ; HL = v
1995+ F510 E5                   push hl
1996+ F511 B7                   or a
1997+ F512 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; v - word (no overflow)
1998+ F514 D1                   pop de                          ; DE = v
1999+ F515 E1                   pop hl                          ; HL -> the high byte
2000+ F516 F0                   ret p                           ; v >= word

2002+ F518 2B                   dec hl
2003+ F519 73                   ld (hl),e
2004+ F51A C9                   ret
2005+ F51B
2006+ F51B              ; HL = t, DE = m -> HL = t - (WALK_R + ROW_M - m) = t + m - WALK_R - ROW_M
2007+ F51B              rc_d:
2008+ F51B 19                   add hl,de
2009+ F51C 11 B8 FE             ld de,-(WALK_R+ROW_M)
2010+ F51F 19                   add hl,de
2011+ F520 C9                   ret
2012+ F521
2013+ F521              ; This frame's (cosY, sinY) into the cell walks' steps (draw_row, occ_row)

2021+ F530                  ENDIF

2024+ F536 22 D0 F3             ld (draw_row.sm+1),hl
2025+ F539                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
2026+ F539 22 80 86             ld (occ_row.sp+1),hl
2027+ F53C 22 1A 87             ld (occ_row.sm+1),hl
2028+ F53F                  ENDIF
2029+ F53F C9                   ret
2030+ F540
2031+ F540              ; A = cell_j: its row's first city_map byte (city_map + j * GRID) -> cell_row

2034+ F541 26 00                ld h,0
2035+ F543                      ROWOFS
2035+ F543 29          >        add hl,hl
2035+ F544 29          >        add hl,hl
2035+ F545 29          >        add hl,hl
2035+ F546 29          >        add hl,hl
2035+ F547 29          >        add hl,hl
2035+ F548 29          >        add hl,hl

2038+ F54D 22 CA FB             ld (cell_row),hl

2041+ F551              ; HL = v, A = k -> HL = v * k, modulo 65536: exactly v added k times (k
2042+ F551              ; small, its product with each byte of v at most 16 bits).  Keeps BC.
2043+ F551              kmul:

2045+ F552 55                   ld d,l

2050+ F558 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; high byte * k: its low byte counts

2054+ F55D 67                   ld h,a

2156+ F5E3                      ; |X|*c <= Z1 with c = cosP - 0.5|sinP|.  Reject the bounding circle
2157+ F5E3                      ; (radius BLD_R) round the cell's yaw-space centre (X, Z1, kept up
2158+ F5E3                      ; to date in HL', DE' by the walk).  First, as it needs nothing else:
2159+ F5E3                      ; most cells it rejects then cost no more.  (Level flight: c is
2160+ F5E3                      ; exactly 1.0, so no multiply.)

2555+ F995              ; IX -> a building corner whose outcode is 0 -> its screen x and y in (ix+7)
2556+ F995              ; and (ix+8).  The same arithmetic as vtx_proj (project, zpatch and
2557+ F995              ; scale_comp, step for step), so the same pixels, in one routine: Z's shift
2558+ F995              ; chosen by a branch (three ways) rather than patched in, X and Y made

   1+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 8000              ; Z-POLICE - the second city page (8K page PAGE_CITY2, runs at $8000 in slot
   3+ 8000              ; 4: CITY2_MMU)
   4+ 8000              ;
   5+ 8000              ; More of the Layer 2 drawing, paged in beside the city page (slot 7) for the
   6+ 8000              ; city part of each frame: main_loop maps it over the ULA screen after
   7+ 8000              ; clear_screen and puts the ULA screen back before draw_hud.  Nothing in that
   8+ 8000              ; part of the frame uses the ULA screen (the video hardware shows it from
   9+ 8000              ; bank 5 whatever the CPU has mapped), and the interrupt routine uses only
  10+ 8000              ; slots 1 and 5, so interrupts stay on.  Both pages are mapped together, so
  11+ 8000              ; code and data in either call or use the other directly (labels are global).
  12+ 8000              ;
  13+ 8000              ; Here: the street dots, the bullets, rockets and particles, the gunsight and
  14+ 8000              ; the occlusion culling.  Their variables stay in the city page.  Anything
  15+ 8000              ; that calls into this page from outside main_loop's city part must map it
  16+ 8000              ; first (nextreg CITY2_MMU,PAGE_CITY2) and put the ULA screen back after.
  17+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
  18+ 8000
  19+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ 8000              ; Street intersection markers - one dot per grid corner near the camera
  21+ 8000              ; whose 4 cells are all open: no building, terrace or pad cell touches it
  22+ 8000              ; (out of bounds counts as open: it is never drawn).  A corner a building
  23+ 8000              ; touches is always drawn over by it (its faces cover their own corners, and
  24+ 8000              ; the box hides those behind it), so it isn't worked out at all.
  25+ 8000              ;   A row's corners have cells j-1 above and j below; each corner shares its
  26+ 8000              ; left pair of cells with the corner before, so one pair is read a corner.
  27+ 8000              ; An open corner's (X, Z1) is its row's first corner's (worked out once, by
  28+ 8000              ; full rotation, only if the row has an open corner) + k (cosY, sinY), k its
  29+ 8000              ; column in the row: exactly what stepping +256 world units k times gives.
  30+ 8000              ;==============================================================================

 820+ 85A9                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
 821+ 85A9              ;==============================================================================
 822+ 85A9              ; Occlusion culling (OCCLUSION_CULL; pitched too with OCC_PITCHED, up to
 823+ 85A9              ; OCC_PMAX: then the columns are tilted, see occ_test and occ_pretest.pit)
 824+ 85A9              ;
 825+ 85A9              ; In level flight every screen column is a vertical slice of the world through
 826+ 85A9              ; the camera.  The cells are walked in exactly the reverse of the painter's
 827+ 85A9              ; order, i.e. front to back.  Each building is transformed as usual, then
 828+ 85A9              ; tested against OCC_YBUF, which holds per column the row from which the
 829+ 85A9              ; screen is known to be covered down to the ground:
 830+ 85A9              ;   * hidden - in every column it spans, its highest point is no higher than
 831+ 85A9              ;     that row - it is dropped;
 832+ 85A9              ;   * otherwise it lowers the row across its columns to its lowest top
 833+ 85A9              ;     corner, and its corners and face settings are kept in a record.
 834+ 85A9              ; The kept buildings and the zombie cells are then drawn back to front.
 835+ 85A9              ; This is safe because buildings that share a column meet the walk front to
 836+ 85A9              ; back (the grid order guarantees it), the camera is above the ground (what
 837+ 85A9              ; is behind sits higher on screen), the cover row is the lowest top corner
 838+ 85A9              ; (an underestimate) and bounds are clamped inwards to the screen.  A
 839+ 85A9              ; building with a corner behind the camera is never dropped and never covers.
 840+ 85A9              ;==============================================================================
 841+ 85A9              OCC_YBUF        equ $4000       ; per column: covered from this row down
 842+ 85A9              OCC_YBUF8       equ $4200       ; per 8 columns: at least the most of
 843+ 85A9                                              ; OCC_YBUF's 8 (its own page, before the
 844+ 85A9                                              ; records), so a hidden test can pass 8
 845+ 85A9                                              ; columns at once
 846+ 85A9              OCC_LIST        equ $4100       ; kept buildings and zombie cells, 2 bytes each
 847+ 85A9              OCC_REC0        equ $43         ; the records' first page; two records a
 848+ 85A9              OCC_RECN        equ $60         ; page (128 bytes each, at +0 and +128), up
 849+ 85A9                                              ; to $5F: 58 records ($6000 on: city_col).
 850+ 85A9                                              ; The busiest street view at the full draw
 851+ 85A9                                              ; distance (8 tiles) keeps 35.
 852+ 85A9              ; Record: copy of vtx's 8 corners, bytes 0-8 of each 16 (X, Y, Z, outcode,
 853+ 85A9              ; sx, sy), at the same offsets from the record's start, and in the first
 854+ 85A9              ; corner's spare bytes
 855+ 85A9              OR_VIS          equ 9           ; bld_vis, bld_mx, bld_mz, col_x, col_z, col_top,
 856+ 85A9              OR_N            equ 7           ;   bld_cut
 857+ 85A9                      ASSERT OR_VIS + OR_N <= 16
 858+ 85A9                      ASSERT bld_cut == bld_vis + OR_N - 1
 859+ 85A9                      ASSERT low OCC_YBUF8 == 0       ; (occ_cut: the low byte is the group)
 860+ 85A9              ; A record in a page's upper half is drawn with the +128 corner lists
 861+ 85A9              ; (face_set = FACE_SET2, city.asm).
 862+ 85A9              ; A list entry is a record's address ($4300-$5FFF), a cell with humans as
 863+ 85A9              ; its city_col address ($6000-$6FFF) or a cell with zombies as its city_map
 864+ 85A9              ; address ($7000-$7FFF).
 865+ 85A9
 866+ 85A9              ; Start of the city: occlusion on in level flight (and with OCC_PITCHED
 867+ 85A9              ; up to OCC_PMAX)
 868+ 85A9              occ_begin:
 869+ 85A9 AF                   xor a
 870+ 85AA 32 CF FB             ld (occ_on),a
 871+ 85AD 32 D0 FB             ld (occ_full),a
 872+ 85B0                  IFNDEF OCC_PITCHED
 873+ 85B0 ~                    ld a,(pitch)
 874+ 85B0 ~                    or a
 875+ 85B0 ~                    ret nz
 876+ 85B0                  ELSE
 877+ 85B0 3A C8 AF             ld a,(pitch)                    ; pitched past OCC_PMAX: the plain way
 878+ 85B3 CB 7F                bit 7,a                         ; (the sides lean too far, the bounds
 879+ 85B5 28 02                jr z,.pp                        ; are loose: it costs more than it
 880+ 85B7 ED 44                neg                             ; saves)
 881+ 85B9 FE 13        .pp:    cp OCC_PMAX+1
 882+ 85BB D0                   ret nc
 883+ 85BC 21 78 01             ld hl,2*OCC_R                   ; occ_pretest's pitched bounds
 884+ 85BF ED 5B D0 B6          ld de,(cos_p)
 885+ 85C3 CD 84 AF             call fmul

 887+ 85C9 21 78 01             ld hl,2*OCC_R

 894+ 85DD AF                   xor a
 895+ 85DE                  ENDIF

 897+ 85DF 32 CF FB             ld (occ_on),a
 898+ 85E2 21 00 41             ld hl,OCC_LIST
 899+ 85E5 22 D1 FB             ld (occ_lp),hl

 901+ 85EB 22 D3 FB             ld (occ_rp),hl

1782+ 8BD4              ;==============================================================================
1783+ 8BD4              ; The figures (zombies, special monsters, humans): their graphics are in

1797+ 8BD4              ; its projected height zhr (at least GFX_MIN_H, fig_size), one level to every

   1+ 4000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 4000              ; Z-POLICE - Layer 2 320x256 graphics (8K page PAGE_L320, runs at $4000 in
   3+ 4000              ; slot 2)
   4+ 4000              ;
   5+ 4000              ; For the screens outside the game: the menus, the load-out, level complete
   6+ 4000              ; and game over.  They're mostly text, so they use Layer 2's 320x256 mode
   7+ 4000              ; (40 x 32 characters of 8x8, the whole screen, border included) in place of
   8+ 4000              ; the ULA.  This page has everything they draw with:
   9+ 4000              ;   l320_mode320 / l320_mode256   switch the display to 320x256 / back to the
  10+ 4000              ;                                 game's 256x192
  11+ 4000              ;   l320_screen                   a screen's start: cleared, framed, shown
  12+ 4000              ;                                 (screen320, text.asm, calls it)
  13+ 4000              ;   l320_cls                      clear the screen to a colour (by DMA)
  14+ 4000              ;   l320_at, l320_pos             set the text position (character / pixel)
  15+ 4000              ;   l320_char, l320_print,        text: one character, a string (with colour
  16+ 4000              ;   l320_print_at,                  and position codes), a string at a row
  17+ 4000              ;   l320_print_list                 and column (menu_print's registers), a
  18+ 4000              ;                                   table of strings
  19+ 4000              ;   l320_recolour, l320_swap      change colours already drawn: a run of
  20+ 4000              ;                                 text cells (highlighting), or one colour in
  21+ 4000              ;                                 a box
  22+ 4000              ;   l320_plot, l320_line,         pixels, lines, filled boxes, outlines
  23+ 4000              ;   l320_fill, l320_hline,
  24+ 4000              ;   l320_vline, l320_box
  25+ 4000              ;
  26+ 4000              ; Use: page it in, switch, clear, draw:
  27+ 4000              ;       nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320      ; this page at $4000 (slot 2)
  28+ 4000              ;       ld a,L320_BLACK
  29+ 4000              ;       call l320_cls
  30+ 4000              ;       call l320_mode320
  31+ 4000              ; and on leaving for the game, switch back and put the occlusion page back
  32+ 4000              ; in slot 2 (l2_game_mode, zpolice.asm, does both).
  33+ 4000              ;
  34+ 4000              ; Slot 2 is the occlusion data's, used only while the city is drawn, so it
  35+ 4000              ; is free on these screens: they run in slot 6, with the keys (and the
  36+ 4000              ; sprites, sound, file handler) in slot 7, the resident page in slot 5, the
  37+ 4000              ; zombie page (and the IM 2 table) in slot 1 and the city bank in slot 3.
  38+ 4000              ;
  39+ 4000              ; The screen: 5 16K banks from L2_BANK_A (banks 9-13, pages 18-27: the first
  40+ 4000              ; game buffer and part of the second, unused while these screens are up;
  41+ 4000              ; the game clears both before it draws).  320x256 is column-major: pixel
  42+ 4000              ; (x, y) is byte x*256 + y, so each 8K page is 32 columns of 256 pixels and
  43+ 4000              ; a column's pixels are in one page.  Writes go through slot 0, as the game's
  44+ 4000              ; do: (x, y) is page 18 + x/32, at $0000 + (x & 31)*256 + y.
  45+ 4000              ;
  46+ 4000              ; Colours: Layer 2's second palette, set to RRRGGGBB (the colour is the
  47+ 4000              ; byte; the level's palette is the first one and is left alone).  $E3 is
  48+ 4000              ; the transparency colour: it is never drawn, and as a paper it means "leave
  49+ 4000              ; the background" (L320_NOPAPER).
  50+ 4000              ;
  51+ 4000              ; Registers: every routine may change AF, BC, DE, HL unless it says so; IX,
  52+ 4000              ; IY and the alternate set are kept.  The text uses the resident 8x8 font
  53+ 4000              ; (font8, text.asm: ASCII 32-95; lower case is drawn as upper case).
  54+ 4000              ;==============================================================================
  55+ 4000
  56+ 4000              L320_W          equ 320             ; pixels
  57+ 4000              L320_H          equ 256

 322+ E200              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 323+ E200              ; Weapon slots: a column for each, at columns WPN_COL0, +2, ... in the order
 324+ E200              ; wpn_order (as numbered on keys 1-5: 2 4 1 5 3).  From the top:
 325+ E200              ;   * row WPN_NUM_ROW: its slot number, yellow if selected; none if unused;
 326+ E200              ;   * rows WPN_ROW..: a bar 1 character wide and WPN_BAR high, its ammo one
 327+ E200              ;     digit a row in black, hundreds at the top (infinite ammo: INF).  Green;
 328+ E200              ;     red with no ammo left; black if unused.  An unused slot that was asked
 329+ E200              ;     for flashes amber / black (WFLASH frames each, 3 times);
 330+ E200              ;   * row WPN_LTR_ROW: the letter of its weapon (wpn_glyph), yellow if
 331+ E200              ;     selected.
 332+ E200              ; The selected slot also has a yellow line above and below the bar, in the
 333+ E200              ; number's and the letter's cells (a cell has one ink: in the bar's they
 334+ E200              ; would be black).  Checked every frame, redrawn only when it changes
 335+ E200              ; (wd_shown).
 336+ E200              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 337+ E200              WPN_ATTR_ON     equ C_OK<<3             ; paper green, ink black
 338+ E200              WPN_ATTR_OUT    equ C_WARN<<3           ; paper red
 339+ E200              WPN_ATTR_OFF    equ P_EMPTY<<3          ; paper black

 344+ E200                      ASSERT WPN_NUM_ROW/8 == WPN_LTR_ROW/8   ; the rows in one third

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - input: keyboard and joysticks (8K page PAGE_INPUT, runs at
   3+ E000              ; $E000 in slot 7: main_loop and the menu page it in, and the game logic
   4+ E000              ; pages in slot 6 call it)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; Redefinable controls.  An input (a key, or a joystick direction or button)
   7+ E000              ; is a 16-bit code: high byte = input bank, low byte = bit mask within it.
   8+ E000              ;   banks 0-7: the ZX Spectrum keyboard half-rows (port $xxFE, address line
   9+ E000              ;              A8+bank low): read 0 = pressed
  10+ E000              ;   bank 8:    NextReg $B0, Extended Keys 0: read 1 = pressed
  11+ E000              ;   bank 9:    NextReg $B1, Extended Keys 1: read 1 = pressed
  12+ E000              ;   bank 10:   port $1F, Kempston 1 / Mega Drive 1 (J1_*): read 1 = pressed
  13+ E000              ;   bank 11:   port $37, Kempston 2 / Mega Drive 2 (J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  14+ E000              ;   bank 12:   NextReg $B2, the 6-button Mega Drive pads' X, Y, Z and MODE
  15+ E000              ;              (left connector J1_*, right J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  16+ E000              ; A joystick bank is read only while a joystick is set (NextReg $05, the
  17+ E000              ; Next's joystick modes) to the port it reads, else it is 0: so an unused
  18+ E000              ; port can't read as everything pressed.  Joysticks in Sinclair or Cursor
  19+ E000              ; mode enter keys (6-0, 1-5, 5-8) and are read as keys.
  20+ E000              ; kbd_scan, once per frame at the top of the main loop, reads all the banks
  21+ E000              ; into key_now, inverting the ZX rows so that every bank holds 1 = pressed,
  22+ E000              ; and keeps the previous scan in key_prev.  The game asks about actions
  23+ E000              ; (K_FIRE, K_LEFT, ...), not inputs: each action has a key (key_defs) and a
  24+ E000              ; joystick input (joy_defs; 0 = none), either of which works, so both can
  25+ E000              ; be redefined (key_define) at any time.
  26+ E000              ;   key_held    A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input is down
  27+ E000              ;   key_pressed A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input went down
  28+ E000              ;               since the last scan
  29+ E000              ;   key_find    -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (for a
  30+ E000              ;               redefine screen); Z if none
  31+ E000              ;   key_code_pressed  HL = key code -> NZ if that key went down
  32+ E000              ; The Next normally also enters the extended keys into the 8x5 matrix (e.g.
  33+ E000              ; cursor LEFT as CAPS SHIFT + 5).  NextReg $68 bit 4 stops that: set it with
  34+ E000              ; kbd_double_on (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE), clear it with kbd_double_off
  35+ E000              ; (FALSE, the default).
  36+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  37+ E000
  38+ E000              ; --- key codes: bank << 8 | mask ---------------------------------------------

 149+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 150+ E000              ; Read all the input banks: key_prev = last scan, key_now = this one, every
 151+ E000              ; bit 1 = pressed
 152+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 153+ E000              kbd_scan:
 154+ E000 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 155+ E003 11 63 E1             ld de,key_prev
 156+ E006 01 0D 00             ld bc,KEY_BANKS
 157+ E009 ED B0                ldir
 158+ E00B 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 159+ E00E 01 FE FE             ld bc,$FEFE                     ; banks 0-7: half-rows $FE..$7F
 160+ E011 ED 78        .row:   in a,(c)
 161+ E013 2F                   cpl                             ; 0 = pressed -> 1 = pressed
 162+ E014 E6 1F                and %00011111
 163+ E016 77                   ld (hl),a
 164+ E017 23                   inc hl
 165+ E018 CB 00                rlc b                           ; next half-row
 166+ E01A 38 F5                jr c,.row                       ; (stops after $7F)
