   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 44          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 2C                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl
  89+ E027 36 40                ld (hl),$40                     ; hidden, 5-byte form, pattern 0
  90+ E029 23                   inc hl
  91+ E02A 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; scale x1
  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:
 101+ E02E 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 102+ E031 AF                   xor a
 103+ E032 ED 79                out (c),a                       ; from sprite 0
 104+ E034 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 105+ E037 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
 106+ E039 16 2C                ld d,SPR_COUNT
 107+ E03B 06 05        .lp:    ld b,SPR_ATTR
 108+ E03D ED B3                otir
 109+ E03F 15                   dec d
 110+ E040 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 111+ E042 C9                   ret
 112+ E043
 113+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 114+ E043              ; Load B 8-bit patterns (256 bytes each) from HL into pattern memory, from
 115+ E043              ; pattern A (0..63).  HL ends past them.
 116+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 117+ E043              spr_patterns:
 118+ E043 50                   ld d,b
 119+ E044 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 120+ E047 ED 79                out (c),a
 121+ E049 0E 5B                ld c,SPR_PAT_PORT
 122+ E04B 06 00        .lp:    ld b,0                          ; 256 bytes
 123+ E04D ED B3                otir
 124+ E04F 15                   dec d
 125+ E050 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 126+ E052 C9                   ret
 127+ E053
 128+ E053              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 129+ E053              ; Load B colours (8-bit RRRGGGBB) from HL into the sprite palette, from
 130+ E053              ; index A.  (It starts as the identity: only needed for other colours.)
 131+ E053              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 132+ E053              spr_palette:
 133+ E053 ED 91 43 20          nextreg $43,%00100000           ; edit the first sprite palette
 134+ E057 ED 92 40             nextreg $40,a
 135+ E05A 7E           .lp:    ld a,(hl)
 136+ E05B ED 92 41             nextreg $41,a
 137+ E05E 23                   inc hl
 138+ E05F 10 F9                djnz .lp
 139+ E061 C9                   ret
 140+ E062
 141+ E062              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 142+ E062              ; Sprite A (0..SPR_COUNT-1) in the shadow table.  BC = x, DE = y (sprite
 143+ E062              ; screen, signed 9 bits), H = pattern (0..63), L = flags (SPRF_*).  Shows it.
 144+ E062              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 145+ E062              spr_set:
 146+ E062 22 08 E1             ld (spr_pf),hl
 147+ E065 F5                   push af
 148+ E066 CD 84 E0             call spr_pos
 149+ E069 F1                   pop af
 150+ E06A CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 151+ E06D 23                   inc hl
 152+ E06E 23                   inc hl                          ; +2: the flags, keeping x bit 8
 153+ E06F 3A 08 E1             ld a,(spr_pf)
 154+ E072 E6 FE                and $FE
 155+ E074 5F                   ld e,a
 156+ E075 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 157+ E076 E6 01                and 1
 158+ E078 B3                   or e
 159+ E079 77                   ld (hl),a
 160+ E07A 23                   inc hl                          ; +3: visible, 5-byte form, pattern
 161+ E07B 3A 09 E1             ld a,(spr_pf+1)
 162+ E07E E6 3F                and $3F
 163+ E080 F6 C0                or $C0
 164+ E082 77                   ld (hl),a
 165+ E083 C9                   ret
 166+ E084
 167+ E084              ; Sprite A: move to BC = x, DE = y (signed 9 bits)
 168+ E084              spr_pos:
 169+ E084 D5                   push de
 170+ E085 CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 171+ E088 D1                   pop de
 172+ E089 71                   ld (hl),c                       ; +0 x bits 0-7
 173+ E08A 23                   inc hl
 174+ E08B 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; +1 y bits 0-7
 175+ E08C 23                   inc hl
 176+ E08D 78                   ld a,b                          ; +2 bit 0: x bit 8
 177+ E08E E6 01                and 1
 178+ E090 47                   ld b,a
 179+ E091 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 180+ E092 E6 FE                and $FE
 181+ E094 B0                   or b
 182+ E095 77                   ld (hl),a
 183+ E096 23                   inc hl
 184+ E097 23                   inc hl
 185+ E098 7A                   ld a,d                          ; +4 bit 0: y bit 8
 186+ E099 E6 01                and 1
 187+ E09B 57                   ld d,a
 188+ E09C 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 189+ E09D E6 FE                and $FE
 190+ E09F B2                   or d
 191+ E0A0 77                   ld (hl),a
 192+ E0A1 C9                   ret
 193+ E0A2
 194+ E0A2              ; Sprite A: pattern E (0..63), keeping whether it is shown
 195+ E0A2              spr_pattern:
 196+ E0A2 CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 197+ E0A5 7D                   ld a,l
 198+ E0A6 C6 03                add a,3
 199+ E0A8 6F                   ld l,a
 200+ E0A9 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 201+ E0AA E6 C0                and $C0
 202+ E0AC B3                   or e
 203+ E0AD 77                   ld (hl),a
 204+ E0AE C9                   ret
 205+ E0AF
 206+ E0AF              ; Sprite A: flags E (SPRF_*: palette offset, mirrors, rotation)
 207+ E0AF              spr_flags:
 208+ E0AF CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 209+ E0B2 23                   inc hl
 210+ E0B3 23                   inc hl
 211+ E0B4 7B                   ld a,e
 212+ E0B5 E6 FE                and $FE
 213+ E0B7 5F                   ld e,a
 214+ E0B8 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 215+ E0B9 E6 01                and 1
 216+ E0BB B3                   or e
 217+ E0BC 77                   ld (hl),a
 218+ E0BD C9                   ret
 219+ E0BE
 220+ E0BE              ; Sprite A: scale E across, D down (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8)
 221+ E0BE              spr_scale:
 222+ E0BE D5                   push de
 223+ E0BF CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 224+ E0C2 D1                   pop de
 225+ E0C3 7D                   ld a,l
 226+ E0C4 C6 04                add a,4
 227+ E0C6 6F                   ld l,a
 228+ E0C7 7B                   ld a,e
 229+ E0C8 E6 03                and 3
 230+ E0CA 07                   rlca
 231+ E0CB 07                   rlca
 232+ E0CC 5F                   ld e,a
 233+ E0CD 7A                   ld a,d
 234+ E0CE E6 03                and 3
 235+ E0D0 B3                   or e
 236+ E0D1 07                   rlca                            ; x scale bits 4-3, y scale 2-1
 237+ E0D2 5F                   ld e,a
 238+ E0D3 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 239+ E0D4 E6 01                and 1                           ; (keep y bit 8)
 240+ E0D6 B3                   or e
 241+ E0D7 77                   ld (hl),a
 242+ E0D8 C9                   ret
 243+ E0D9
 244+ E0D9              ; Sprite A: hide / show
 245+ E0D9              spr_hide:
 246+ E0D9 CD F7 E0             call spr_addr3
 247+ E0DC CB BE                res 7,(hl)
 248+ E0DE C9                   ret
 249+ E0DF              spr_show:
 250+ E0DF CD F7 E0             call spr_addr3
 251+ E0E2 CB FE                set 7,(hl)
 252+ E0E4 C9                   ret
 253+ E0E5
 254+ E0E5              ; Hide every sprite in the table
 255+ E0E5              spr_hide_all:
 256+ E0E5 AF                   xor a                           ; (the viewport's frame: set it again)
 257+ E0E6 32 46 E4             ld (frm_on),a
 258+ E0E9 21 03 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow+3
 259+ E0EC 11 05 00             ld de,SPR_ATTR
 260+ E0EF 06 2C                ld b,SPR_COUNT
 261+ E0F1 CB BE        .lp:    res 7,(hl)
 262+ E0F3 19                   add hl,de
 263+ E0F4 10 FB                djnz .lp
 264+ E0F6 C9                   ret
 265+ E0F7
 266+ E0F7              ; A = sprite -> HL -> its attributes in the table, +3 for spr_addr3.
 267+ E0F7              ; (The table doesn't cross a 256-byte boundary, so +n is just L + n.)
 268+ E0F7              spr_addr3:
 269+ E0F7 CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 270+ E0FA 23                   inc hl
 271+ E0FB 23                   inc hl
 272+ E0FC 23                   inc hl
 273+ E0FD C9                   ret
 274+ E0FE              spr_addr:
 275+ E0FE 57                   ld d,a
 276+ E0FF 1E 05                ld e,SPR_ATTR
 277+ E101 ED 30                mul d,e
 278+ E103 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 279+ E106 19                   add hl,de
 280+ E107 C9                   ret
 281+ E108
 282+ E108              ;==============================================================================
 283+ E108              ; Sprite data
 284+ E108              ;==============================================================================
 285+ E108              ; The patterns themselves are in the sprite banks (sprite_data.asm).
 286+ E108              ; Bank 0 has the human status sprites, loaded as patterns 0-3 by
 287+ E108              ; sprites_init, after the HUD's passenger markers:
 288+ E108              ;   HSPR_FIELD   0  waiting in the field, not yet rescued: an empty square
 289+ E108              ;   HSPR_ABOARD  1  aboard the VTOL: a person sitting in a chair
 290+ E108              ;   HSPR_SAVED   2  rescued: a green person standing
 291+ E108              ;   HSPR_DEAD    3  dead: a white person with a red cross over them
 292+ E108
 293+ E108 00 00        spr_pf:     dw 0                        ; spr_set: flags, pattern
 294+ E10A 00 00 00...          ALIGN 256
 295+ E200 00 00 00...  spr_shadow: ds SPR_COUNT*SPR_ATTR       ; attributes, as sent (5-byte form)
 296+ E2DC                      ASSERT SPR_COUNT*SPR_ATTR <= 256
 297+ E2DC
# file closed: sprites.asm
2182  E2DC                      INCLUDE "hud_sprites.asm"       ; the human column, the compass bar
# file opened: hud_sprites.asm
   1+ E2DC              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E2DC              ; Z-POLICE - HUD sprites (in the sprites page, PAGE_SPRITES, at $E000 in slot
   3+ E2DC              ; 7): the human status column and the compass bar, as hardware sprites on
   4+ E2DC              ; the 320 x 256 sprite screen.  hud_sprites sets both and sends the sprite
   5+ E2DC              ; table to the hardware; main_loop calls it once a frame, after the flip.
   6+ E2DC              ;
   7+ E2DC              ; Sprites used: 0..HUMAN_MAX-1 the humans, CSPR_SPR0.. the compass bar's
   8+ E2DC              ; marks, CSPR_PTR_SPR its pointer, FRM_SPR0.. the viewport's frame.
   9+ E2DC              ;==============================================================================
  10+ E2DC
  11+ E2DC              hud_sprites:
  12+ E2DC 3A 46 E4             ld a,(frm_on)                   ; the frame, once (they stay set)
  13+ E2DF B7                   or a
  14+ E2E0 CC 4C E3             call z,frame_spr
  15+ E2E3 CD EF E3             call hum_hud
  16+ E2E6 CD 84 E3             call compass_spr
  17+ E2E9 C3 2E E0             jp spr_update
  18+ E2EC
  19+ E2EC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  20+ E2EC              ; The viewport's frame: curved corners and edges in hardware sprites, over
  21+ E2EC              ; Layer 2 and the border, so nothing is drawn into the view.  Set once after
  22+ E2EC              ; the sprites are hidden (frm_on; spr_hide_all clears it).  frame_tab: x, y,
  23+ E2EC              ; pattern and flags, then scale across and down: the edges are 1-row patterns
  24+ E2EC              ; stretched, FRM_H across (two at x8 overlapping, 224 pixels) and FRM_V down
  25+ E2EC              ; (two at x4 overlapping, 96).  The panel's bottom corners are rounded too.
  26+ E2EC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  27+ E2EC              FRM_SPR0        equ CSPR_PTR_SPR+1  ; the frame's sprites (12)
  28+ E2EC              FRM_L           equ SPR_SCREEN_X
  29+ E2EC              FRM_R           equ SPR_SCREEN_X+256-SPR_SIZE
  30+ E2EC              FRM_T           equ SPR_SCREEN_Y
  31+ E2EC              FRM_B           equ SPR_SCREEN_Y+VIEW_H-SPR_SIZE
  32+ E2EC              FRM_PB          equ SPR_SCREEN_Y+192-SPR_SIZE   ; the panel's bottom corners
  33+ E2EC              FRM_X8          equ 3               ; (scale codes)
  34+ E2EC              FRM_X4          equ 2
  35+ E2EC              FRM_REC         equ 8
  36+ E2EC
  37+ E2EC              frame_tab:
  38+ E2EC 20 00 20 00          dw FRM_L, FRM_T
  39+ E2F0 0B 00 00 00          db FRM_CRN, 0, 0, 0
  40+ E2F4 10 01 20 00          dw FRM_R, FRM_T
  41+ E2F8 0B 08 00 00          db FRM_CRN, SPRF_XMIRROR, 0, 0
  42+ E2FC 20 00 90 00          dw FRM_L, FRM_B
  43+ E300 0C 04 00 00          db FRM_CRN_P, SPRF_YMIRROR, 0, 0
  44+ E304 10 01 90 00          dw FRM_R, FRM_B
  45+ E308 0C 0C 00 00          db FRM_CRN_P, SPRF_XMIRROR|SPRF_YMIRROR, 0, 0
  46+ E30C 20 00 D0 00          dw FRM_L, FRM_PB
  47+ E310 0D 04 00 00          db FRM_CRN_S, SPRF_YMIRROR, 0, 0
  48+ E314 10 01 D0 00          dw FRM_R, FRM_PB
  49+ E318 0D 0C 00 00          db FRM_CRN_S, SPRF_XMIRROR|SPRF_YMIRROR, 0, 0
  50+ E31C 30 00 20 00          dw FRM_L+SPR_SIZE, FRM_T                ; the top edge
  51+ E320 0E 00 03 00          db FRM_H, 0, FRM_X8, 0
  52+ E324 90 00 20 00          dw FRM_R-16*8, FRM_T
  53+ E328 0E 00 03 00          db FRM_H, 0, FRM_X8, 0
  54+ E32C 20 00 30 00          dw FRM_L, FRM_T+SPR_SIZE                ; the left edge
  55+ E330 0F 00 00 02          db FRM_V, 0, 0, FRM_X4
  56+ E334 20 00 50 00          dw FRM_L, FRM_B-16*4
  57+ E338 0F 00 00 02          db FRM_V, 0, 0, FRM_X4
  58+ E33C 10 01 30 00          dw FRM_R, FRM_T+SPR_SIZE                ; the right edge
  59+ E340 0F 08 00 02          db FRM_V, SPRF_XMIRROR, 0, FRM_X4
  60+ E344 10 01 50 00          dw FRM_R, FRM_B-16*4
  61+ E348 0F 08 00 02          db FRM_V, SPRF_XMIRROR, 0, FRM_X4
  62+ E34C              frame_tab_end:
  63+ E34C              FRM_COUNT       equ (frame_tab_end-frame_tab)/FRM_REC
  64+ E34C                      ASSERT FRM_SPR0+FRM_COUNT == SPR_COUNT
  65+ E34C
  66+ E34C              frame_spr:
  67+ E34C 3E 01                ld a,1
  68+ E34E 32 46 E4             ld (frm_on),a
  69+ E351 DD 21 EC E2          ld ix,frame_tab
  70+ E355 3E 20                ld a,FRM_SPR0
  71+ E357 F5           .lp:    push af
  72+ E358 DD 4E 00             ld c,(ix+0)
  73+ E35B DD 46 01             ld b,(ix+1)
  74+ E35E DD 5E 02             ld e,(ix+2)
  75+ E361 DD 56 03             ld d,(ix+3)
  76+ E364 DD 66 04             ld h,(ix+4)
  77+ E367 DD 6E 05             ld l,(ix+5)
  78+ E36A CD 62 E0             call spr_set
  79+ E36D F1                   pop af
  80+ E36E F5                   push af
  81+ E36F DD 5E 06             ld e,(ix+6)
  82+ E372 DD 56 07             ld d,(ix+7)
  83+ E375 CD BE E0             call spr_scale
  84+ E378 11 08 00             ld de,FRM_REC
  85+ E37B DD 19                add ix,de
  86+ E37D F1                   pop af
  87+ E37E 3C                   inc a
  88+ E37F FE 2C                cp FRM_SPR0+FRM_COUNT
  89+ E381 20 D4                jr nz,.lp
  90+ E383 C9                   ret
  91+ E384
  92+ E384              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  93+ E384              ; The compass bar, across the top of the screen in the top border (sprite
  94+ E384              ; row COMP_SPR_Y): a tape of marks every 16 yaw units (22.5 degrees), at 2
  95+ E384              ; pixels a yaw unit, centred on the heading at sprite x COMP_SPR_CX, across
  96+ E384              ; the full 320-pixel width of the sprite screen: 225 degrees (+-COMP_HALF,
  97+ E384              ; 80 yaw units).  Marks at the very edges are half off the screen (their x
  98+ E384              ; wraps, as sprite x does).  The letters N,
  99+ E384              ; E, S, W (red) at 0, 64, 128, 192; a yellow dot at the 45 degree points;
 100+ E384              ; a small white dot between.  A white pointer under the bar's middle marks
 101+ E384              ; the heading.  Turning right (yaw up) moves the marks left.
 102+ E384              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 103+ E384              CSPR_SPR0       equ HUMAN_MAX       ; first compass mark sprite (20)
 104+ E384              COMP_HALF       equ 80              ; yaw units shown either side: 160 px
 105+ E384              CSPR_MARKS      equ 2*COMP_HALF/16+1    ; most marks in view at once (11)
 106+ E384              CSPR_PTR_SPR    equ CSPR_SPR0+CSPR_MARKS   ; the pointer's sprite
 107+ E384              COMP_SPR_Y      equ 8               ; the bar's sprite row
 108+ E384              COMP_PTR_Y      equ COMP_SPR_Y+SPR_SIZE    ; the pointer, under it
 109+ E384              COMP_SPR_CX     equ 160             ; the heading's x: the screen's middle
 110+ E384              COMP_SPR_X0     equ COMP_SPR_CX-2*COMP_HALF-SPR_SIZE/2  ; x of a mark =
 111+ E384                                                  ; this + 2 * (COMP_HALF + mark - yaw)
 112+ E384                      ASSERT CSPR_PTR_SPR < SPR_COUNT
 113+ E384                      ASSERT CSPR_E == CSPR_N+1 && CSPR_S == CSPR_N+2 && CSPR_W == CSPR_N+3

 120+ E38C 79                   ld a,c
 121+ E38D 87                   add a,a
 122+ E38E 87                   add a,a

   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - start-up initialisation (8K page PAGE_INIT, runs at $E000 in

   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Code needed only once, at start-up, kept out of the resident page: start
   6+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm) pages this in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INIT and calls

# file opened: file_handler.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name
  42+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  43+ E000
  44+ E000              ; esxDOS function codes (the byte after RST $08)
  45+ E000              M_GETSETDRV     equ $89             ; A = 0: get the default drive
  46+ E000              F_OPEN          equ $9A
  47+ E000              F_CLOSE         equ $9B
  48+ E000              F_READ          equ $9D
  49+ E000              F_WRITE         equ $9E
  50+ E000              F_SEEK          equ $9F
  51+ E000              F_FSTAT         equ $A1
  52+ E000              F_UNLINK        equ $AD
  53+ E000
  54+ E000              ; F_OPEN modes (B)
  55+ E000              FA_READ         equ $01             ; read
  56+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  57+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only
  58+ E000              FA_OPEN_AL      equ $08             ; open, or create if it doesn't exist
  59+ E000              FA_CREATE_NEW   equ $04             ; create, fail if it exists
  60+ E000              FA_CREATE_AL    equ $0C             ; create, replacing any existing file
  61+ E000              FA_OVERWRITE    equ FA_WRITE|FA_CREATE_AL   ; for saving a whole file
  62+ E000
  63+ E000              ; F_SEEK modes (L)
  64+ E000              SEEK_START      equ 0               ; from the start of the file
  65+ E000              SEEK_FWD        equ 1               ; forwards from the current position
  66+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position
  67+ E000
  68+ E000              FSTAT_SIZE      equ 7               ; F_FSTAT buffer: file size, 4 bytes
  69+ E000              FSTAT_LEN       equ 11              ; F_FSTAT buffer length
  70+ E000
  71+ E000              ESX_DEFAULT     equ '*'             ; drive: the default drive
  72+ E000
  73+ E000              ; An esxDOS call: the ROM in at $0000-$3FFF for the RST $08, the game's
  74+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  75+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).
  76+ E000                      MACRO ESXDOS fn
  77+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_in
  78+ E000 ~                    rst $08
  79+ E000 ~                    db fn
  80+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_out
  81+ E000                      ENDM

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - audio (8K page PAGE_AUDIO, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in
   3+ E000              ; with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08) and the AY
   8+ E000              ; outputs to stereo (NextReg $09).  init_audio then sets every chip to a
   9+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_clear).
  10+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  11+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  12+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  13+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B) or ld (sfx3_req),a
  14+ E000              ; (AY 3's C), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  15+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  16+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).
  17+ E000              ;
  18+ E000              ; TurboSound ports:
  19+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  20+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;
  21+ E000              ;         any value 0..15: select that register of the selected chip
  22+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register
  23+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  24+ E000
  25+ E000              AY_CTRL_PORT    equ $FFFD           ; chip / register select
  26+ E000              AY_DATA_PORT    equ $BFFD           ; register value
  27+ E000
  28+ E000              ; Chip select ($FFFD): AY_SELECT | AY_LEFT | AY_RIGHT | AY_CHIP_n
  29+ E000              AY_SELECT       equ %10011100       ; bit 7 and bits 4-2 must be set
  30+ E000              AY_LEFT         equ %01000000       ; left output on
  31+ E000              AY_RIGHT        equ %00100000       ; right output on
  32+ E000              AY_CHIP_1       equ %11
  33+ E000              AY_CHIP_2       equ %10
  34+ E000              AY_CHIP_3       equ %01
  35+ E000
  36+ E000              ; AY registers
  37+ E000              AY_TONE_A       equ 0               ; channel A tone period: fine, coarse (4)
  38+ E000              AY_TONE_B       equ 2
  39+ E000              AY_TONE_C       equ 4
  40+ E000              AY_NOISE        equ 6               ; noise period (5 bits)
  41+ E000              AY_MIXER        equ 7               ; tone / noise enable, 0 = on:
  42+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_A    equ %00000001       ;   bits 0-2 tone A-C off,
  43+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_B    equ %00000010
  44+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_C    equ %00000100
  45+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_A   equ %00001000       ;   bits 3-5 noise A-C off
  46+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_B   equ %00010000
  47+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_C   equ %00100000
  48+ E000              AY_VOL_A        equ 8               ; amplitude 0-15 (bit 4: use envelope)
  49+ E000              AY_VOL_B        equ 9
  50+ E000              AY_VOL_C        equ 10
  51+ E000              AY_ENV_FINE     equ 11              ; envelope period
  52+ E000              AY_ENV_COARSE   equ 12
  53+ E000              AY_ENV_SHAPE    equ 13              ; envelope shape
  54+ E000              AY_REGS         equ 14
  55+ E000
  56+ E000              AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD equ %1101        ; envelope: rise once, then hold
  57+ E000              AY_MIXER_INIT   equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  58+ E000                                                  ; tones on, noise off
  59+ E000
  60+ E000              ; The engines (AY 1): jet turbines, from n = |speed| (at least 1: the idle,
  61+ E000              ; at zero throttle, sounds as speed 1), 1..SPEED_MAX
  62+ E000              ENG_MIXER       equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  63+ E000                                                  ; A noise only, B and C tone only
  64+ E000              ENG_NOISE0      equ 29              ; A, the roar: noise period 29 - n*13/16
  65+ E000              ENG_NOISE_MUL   equ 13              ;   (29 at idle, a rumble; 7 flat out, a hiss)
  66+ E000              ENG_ROAR_VOL0   equ 4               ;   volume 4 + n*7/32 (4..10)
  67+ E000              ENG_WHINE0      equ 222             ; B, the turbine whine: period 222 - 3n
  68+ E000              ENG_WHINE_STEP  equ 3               ;   (~500 Hz at idle, ~790 Hz flat out)
  69+ E000              ENG_WHINE_VOL0  equ 2               ;   volume 2 + n*7/32 (2..8)
  70+ E000              ENG_VOL_MUL     equ 7               ; the volumes rise by n*7/32 (0..6)
  71+ E000              ENG_DETUNE      equ 2               ; C, the same whine 2 periods lower: the
  72+ E000              ENG_SHIMMER_VOL equ 2               ;   two beat (the turbines' shimmer), 2 quieter
  73+ E000              ; Sound effects (sfx_tick, interrupts.asm): their numbers, and the step codes
  74+ E000              SFX_MG          equ 1               ; the machine gun: one round
  75+ E000              SFX_LASER       equ 2               ; the pulse laser: one pulse (a zap)
  76+ E000              SFX_CHAIN       equ 3               ; the chain gun: one round
  77+ E000              SFX_ROCKET      equ 4               ; a rocket fired: a short woosh
  78+ E000              SFX_MISSILE     equ 5               ; a missile fired: a longer woosh
  79+ E000              SFX_AUTOCANNON  equ 6               ; the autocannon / proximity cannon: one shell
  80+ E000              SFX_BOOM_ROCKET equ 7               ; explosions (AY 3, sfx2_req): a rocket's,
  81+ E000              SFX_BOOM_MISSILE equ 8              ;   a missile's,
  82+ E000              SFX_BOOM_AUTOCANNON equ 9           ;   an autocannon shell's,
  83+ E000              SFX_BOOM_PROX   equ 10              ;   a proximity shell's
  84+ E000              SFX_SPLAT       equ 11              ; a zombie hit (AY 3 channel C, sfx3_req)
  85+ E000              SFX_CRASH       equ 12              ; the VTOL hitting a building (AY 3, sfx2_req)
  86+ E000              SFX_LOCK        equ 13              ; the missile lock: a double beep (AY 2)
  87+ E000              SFX_LAST        equ 13              ; (sfx_table, sfx_data.asm)
  88+ E000              SFX_STEP        equ $FE             ; end of a step: the next, next interrupt
  89+ E000              SFX_END         equ $FF             ; end of the sound
  90+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  91+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only, B tone only
  92+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_AB equ AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  93+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A and B tones only
  94+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  95+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only
  96+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_A  equ AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  97+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A tone only
  98+ E000              SFX_MIX_BOOM    equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  99+ E000                                                  ; AY 3's mixer: A noise, B tone (the
 100+ E000                                                  ; explosions), C tone (the splats)
 101+ E000                      ASSERT AY_REGS < SFX_STEP
 102+ E000
 103+ E000              ENG_FRAC        equ 16              ; the engines' speed (eng_cur) in 1/16 steps:
 104+ E000              ENG_SPIN_UP     equ 4               ;   up by at most 4/16 an interrupt (12.5 steps
 105+ E000              ENG_SPIN_DOWN   equ 2               ;   a second), down by 2/16 (6.25 a second)
 106+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_SPIN_UP > 0 && ENG_SPIN_DOWN > 0
 107+ E000                      ASSERT -SPEED_MIN <= SPEED_MAX
 108+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE0 - SPEED_MAX*ENG_WHINE_STEP > 0 && ENG_WHINE0 + ENG_DETUNE < 256
 109+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_NOISE0 < 32 && ENG_NOISE0 - (SPEED_MAX*ENG_NOISE_MUL)/16 >= 1
 110+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_ROAR_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15 && ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15
 111+ E000                      ASSERT SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL < 256
 112+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_VOL0 >= ENG_SHIMMER_VOL
 113+ E000
 114+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 115+ E000              ; Set up the sound devices: each AY chip selected with both outputs, every
 116+ E000              ; register 0 (silent: all volumes 0), then the mixer to tones only and the
 117+ E000              ; envelope to attack-and-hold.  AY 1 is left selected.
 118+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 119+ E000              init_audio:

 126+ E00E 6F                   ld l,a
 127+ E00F 22 6A 3C             ld (sfx_ptr),hl
 128+ E012 22 6D 3C             ld (sfx2_ptr),hl
 129+ E015 22 70 3C             ld (sfx3_ptr),hl
 130+ E018 3E 01                ld a,AY_CHIP_3
 131+ E01A CD 24 E0             call ay_init_chip
 132+ E01D 3E 02                ld a,AY_CHIP_2
 133+ E01F CD 24 E0             call ay_init_chip
 134+ E022 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 135+ E024                      ; fall through
 136+ E024
 137+ E024              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it in stereo, clear it, mixer and envelope
 138+ E024              ay_init_chip:
 139+ E024 CD 5D E0             call ay_select
 140+ E027 16 0D                ld d,AY_REGS-1                  ; registers 13..0 = 0
 141+ E029 7A           .clr:   ld a,d

 143+ E02C CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 144+ E02F 15                   dec d

 153+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 154+ E041              ; The VTOL's engines: jet turbines, not rotors, so a steady roar and whine
 155+ E041              ; rather than a chop.  AY 1, all three channels, kept for them.  They never
 156+ E041              ; stop in play: at zero throttle they idle, as at speed 1.  The interrupt
 157+ E041              ; routine plays them, 50 times a second (engine_tick, interrupts.asm): the
 158+ E041              ; sound's speed spools towards the VTOL's, so pitch and volume rise and fall
 159+ E041              ; smoothly.  (The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is
 160+ E041              ; 109375/P Hz.)
 161+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 162+ E041              ; Start of each level (next_level): AY 1's mixer for the engines, the sound's
 163+ E041              ; speed 0 (they spool up to the idle), and the interrupt playing them
 164+ E041              engine_start:

 173+ E054 CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 174+ E057 3E 01                ld a,1
 175+ E059 32 68 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; the interrupt plays them now
 176+ E05C C9                   ret
 177+ E05D
 178+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 179+ E05D              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it, with both outputs on
 180+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 183+ E05F 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 184+ E062 ED 79                out (c),a
 185+ E064 C9                   ret
 186+ E065
 187+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 188+ E065              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected chip.  Keeps D, E, HL.
 189+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E065              ay_write:

 192+ E068 ED 79                out (c),a
 193+ E06A 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 194+ E06C ED 59                out (c),e

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - player page (8K page PAGE_PLAYER, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Keyboard input, movement along the heading, world-edge clamping and
   5+ C000              ; building collision.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,
   6+ C000              ; PAGE_PLAYER, with the keys page (key_held) in slot 7.
   7+ C000              ; Uses the resident helpers get_sin, fmul and bld_height; camera state (cam_x/z/y, yaw, pitch, speed) is shared and
   8+ C000              ; stays in zpolice.asm.
   9+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  10+ C000
  11+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  12+ C000              ; Player input and movement
  13+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  14+ C000              update_player:
  15+ C000 AF                   xor a
  16+ C001 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; border back to black
  17+ C003                      ; remember position in case we fly into something
  18+ C003 21 BD AF             ld hl,cam_x                     ; (and the heading: turning swings
  19+ C006 11 96 C3             ld de,old_pos                   ; the VTOL's nose and tail)

  27+ C018 C3 1B C3             jp vtol_wreck                   ; destroyed: out of control
  28+ C01B              .alive:
  29+ C01B                      ; (keys: kbd_scan has read them; actions from input.asm)
  30+ C01B                      ; --- boost (zpolice.asm: BOOST_*): while on, the speed keys and the
  31+ C01B                      ; air brake don't change the speed, and each frame burns a fuel
  32+ C01B 3A 6F B0             ld a,(boost_on)

  34+ C01F 28 2A                jr z,.nb
  35+ C021 3A C9 AF             ld a,(speed)
  36+ C024 FE 38                cp BOOST_SPEED
  37+ C026 20 18                jr nz,.bend                     ; stopped meanwhile (a collision)
  38+ C028 CD 6E AD             call vtol_on_floor
  39+ C02B 28 13                jr z,.bend                      ; set down: off (the brake stops it)
  40+ C02D 3E 13                ld a,K_BOOST
  41+ C02F CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  42+ C032 20 06                jr nz,.boff                     ; pressed again: off
  43+ C034 21 6E B0             ld hl,boost_fuel
  44+ C037 35                   dec (hl)
  45+ C038 20 0A                jr nz,.bkeep                    ; still burning
  46+ C03A 3A 70 B0     .boff:  ld a,(boost_spd)                ; off (or out of fuel): the speed it
  47+ C03D 32 C9 AF             ld (speed),a                    ; had before
  48+ C040 AF           .bend:  xor a
  49+ C041 32 6F B0             ld (boost_on),a
  50+ C044 AF           .bkeep: xor a                           ; (no air brake this frame)
  51+ C045 32 A2 C3             ld (ab_on),a
  52+ C048 C3 29 C1             jp .nw
  53+ C04B 3E 13        .nb:    ld a,K_BOOST                    ; off: pressed to start it?
  54+ C04D CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  55+ C050 28 2B                jr z,.nbs
  56+ C052 3A 6D B0             ld a,(boost_fitted)
  57+ C055 B7                   or a
  58+ C056 28 25                jr z,.nbs                       ; no booster
  59+ C058 3A 6E B0             ld a,(boost_fuel)
  60+ C05B B7                   or a
  61+ C05C 28 1F                jr z,.nbs                       ; no fuel
  62+ C05E CD 6E AD             call vtol_on_floor
  63+ C061 28 1A                jr z,.nbs                       ; landed: not on the ground
  64+ C063 3A C9 AF             ld a,(speed)
  65+ C066 CB 7F                bit 7,a
  66+ C068 20 13                jr nz,.nbs                      ; reversing
  67+ C06A FE 0E                cp BOOST_MIN
  68+ C06C 38 0F                jr c,.nbs                       ; under half speed
  69+ C06E 32 70 B0             ld (boost_spd),a
  70+ C071 3E 38                ld a,BOOST_SPEED                ; on: twice the top speed at once
  71+ C073 32 C9 AF             ld (speed),a

  73+ C078 32 6F B0             ld (boost_on),a
  74+ C07B 18 C7                jr .bkeep
  75+ C07D              .nbs:
  76+ C07D                      ; --- landed (resting on the road, a roof or the pad): the speed keys
  77+ C07D                      ; only bring it back to 0 (speeding up only from reverse, slowing
  78+ C07D                      ; only from forwards), and any speed is braked away as the air brake
  79+ C07D                      ; does (as if Z were held), with a shake
  80+ C07D CD 6E AD             call vtol_on_floor

  82+ C082 3E 00                ld a,K_SPEED_UP
  83+ C084 CD BE E0             call key_held
  84+ C087 28 0B                jr z,.lq
  85+ C089 3A C9 AF             ld a,(speed)
  86+ C08C CB 7F                bit 7,a
  87+ C08E 28 04                jr z,.lq                        ; not reversing: no

  89+ C091 32 C9 AF             ld (speed),a

  94+ C09E 3D                   dec a
  95+ C09F FA A5 C0             jp m,.lb                        ; at 0 or reversing: no
  96+ C0A2 32 C9 AF             ld (speed),a
  97+ C0A5 3A C9 AF     .lb:    ld a,(speed)

 104+ C0B4 32 C3 AA             ld (shake_t),a

 108+ C0BE              .fly:
 109+ C0BE                      ; --- speed ---
 110+ C0BE 3E 00                ld a,K_SPEED_UP                 ; (by SPEED_STEP, 1)
 111+ C0C0 CD BE E0             call key_held
 112+ C0C3 28 0B                jr z,.nq
 113+ C0C5 3A C9 AF             ld a,(speed)
 114+ C0C8 FE 1C                cp SPEED_MAX
 115+ C0CA 28 04                jr z,.nq
 116+ C0CC 3C                   inc a
 117+ C0CD 32 C9 AF             ld (speed),a
 118+ C0D0 3E 01        .nq:    ld a,K_SPEED_DN
 119+ C0D2 CD BE E0             call key_held
 120+ C0D5 28 0B                jr z,.na
 121+ C0D7 3A C9 AF             ld a,(speed)
 122+ C0DA FE FA                cp (SPEED_MIN) & $FF
 123+ C0DC 28 04                jr z,.na
 124+ C0DE 3D                   dec a
 125+ C0DF 32 C9 AF             ld (speed),a
 126+ C0E2              .na:    ; --- air brake: while held, the speed falls AIRBRAKE_STEP a frame
 127+ C0E2                      ; towards 0, going forwards or backwards.  Each braking frame tips the
 128+ C0E2                      ; nose one pitch step, as a nose key press does: up when braking
 129+ C0E2                      ; forward motion, down when braking reverse.  The pitch damper waits
 130+ C0E2                      ; while it brakes (ab_on), as it does while a nose key is held.

 314+ C263              ; The lateral thrusters (lthrust_fitted): while a strafe control
 315+ C263              ; (K_STRAFE_L, K_STRAFE_R) is held, the VTOL moves STRAFE_D sideways,
 316+ C263              ; square to its heading, each frame; not when landed (resting on the

 318+ C263              STRAFE_D_HALVES equ 5               ; 2.5 world units a frame (0.195 m)

 346+ C2A3              ; HL = S7.8 component -> HL = 2.5 * it: the move in 1/256 units
 347+ C2A3 54           .d:     ld d,h
 348+ C2A4 5D                   ld e,l
 349+ C2A5 CB 2A                sra d
 350+ C2A7 CB 1B                rr e                            ; half

 352+ C2AA 19                   add hl,de
 353+ C2AB C9                   ret
 354+ C2AC                      ASSERT STRAFE_D_HALVES == 5     ; (.d: 2 + 1/2)
 355+ C2AC
 356+ C2AC              ; IX -> 24-bit position (frac, lo, hi). HL = signed delta in 1/256 units.
 357+ C2AC              ; Clamps the integer part to WORLD_MIN..WORLD_MAX.
 358+ C2AC              add_pos:
 359+ C2AC 7C                   ld a,h
 360+ C2AD 17                   rla
 361+ C2AE 9F                   sbc a,a
 362+ C2AF 4F                   ld c,a                          ; sign extension
 363+ C2B0 DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+0)
 364+ C2B3 85                   add a,l
 365+ C2B4 DD 77 00             ld (ix+0),a
 366+ C2B7 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+1)
 367+ C2BA 8C                   adc a,h
 368+ C2BB DD 77 01             ld (ix+1),a
 369+ C2BE DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
 370+ C2C1 89                   adc a,c
 371+ C2C2 DD 77 02             ld (ix+2),a
 372+ C2C5 DD 6E 01             ld l,(ix+1)
 373+ C2C8 DD 66 02             ld h,(ix+2)
 374+ C2CB CB 7C                bit 7,h
 375+ C2CD 20 1B                jr nz,.lo
 376+ C2CF 11 40 00             ld de,WORLD_MIN
 377+ C2D2 B7                   or a
 378+ C2D3 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 379+ C2D5 38 13                jr c,.lo
 380+ C2D7 DD 6E 01             ld l,(ix+1)
 381+ C2DA DD 66 02             ld h,(ix+2)
 382+ C2DD 11 C0 3F             ld de,WORLD_MAX
 383+ C2E0 CD F3 C2             call min_hl_de
 384+ C2E3 DD 75 01             ld (ix+1),l
 385+ C2E6 DD 74 02             ld (ix+2),h
 386+ C2E9 C9                   ret
 387+ C2EA DD 36 01 40  .lo:    ld (ix+1),WORLD_MIN & $FF
 388+ C2EE DD 36 02 00          ld (ix+2),WORLD_MIN >> 8
 389+ C2F2 C9                   ret

 391+ C2F3              ; Unsigned 16-bit clamps
 392+ C2F3              min_hl_de:

 394+ C2F4 B7                   or a

 410+ C303              ; Returns NZ if the VTOL hits a building: its footprint (10 m x 3 m, turned
 411+ C303              ; to the heading; vtol_ground) is over a roof less than COLL_H below it.
 412+ C303              check_collision:

 414+ C306 C8                   ret z                           ; all road

 423+ C318 C9                   ret
 424+ C319 AF           .no:    xor a
 425+ C31A C9                   ret

 427+ C31B              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 428+ C31B              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up
 429+ C31B              ; to DEAD_FALL_MAX), until it hits the ground under it (floor_y: the road,
 430+ C31B              ; or the highest roof under its footprint).  Once down it lies still for
 431+ C31B              ; DEAD_PAUSE frames, then sets game_over (main_loop: the GAME OVER screen,
 432+ C31B              ; then the main menu).
 433+ C31B              vtol_wreck:
 434+ C31B AF                   xor a
 435+ C31C 32 C9 AF             ld (speed),a
 436+ C31F 3A DC AF             ld a,(dead_down)
 437+ C322 B7                   or a
 438+ C323 20 39                jr nz,.down
 439+ C325 2A C5 AF             ld hl,(yaw_frac)                ; spin
 440+ C328 11 00 08             ld de,DEAD_SPIN

 442+ C32C 22 C5 AF             ld (yaw_frac),hl
 443+ C32F 3A DD AF             ld a,(dead_vy)                  ; fall, faster each frame
 444+ C332 FE 08                cp DEAD_FALL_MAX
 445+ C334 30 04                jr nc,.vy
 446+ C336 3C                   inc a
 447+ C337 32 DD AF             ld (dead_vy),a
 448+ C33A 5F           .vy:    ld e,a
 449+ C33B 16 00                ld d,0
 450+ C33D 2A C3 AF             ld hl,(cam_y)
 451+ C340 B7                   or a
 452+ C341 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 453+ C343 30 03                jr nc,.y
 454+ C345 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 455+ C348 E5           .y:     push hl
 456+ C349 CD 09 AB             call floor_y                    ; HL = the ground under it
 457+ C34C EB                   ex de,hl
 458+ C34D E1                   pop hl
 459+ C34E B7                   or a
 460+ C34F ED 52                sbc hl,de
 461+ C351 19                   add hl,de
 462+ C352 30 06                jr nc,.set                      ; still above it
 463+ C354 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; hit the ground: on it
 464+ C355 3E 01                ld a,1
 465+ C357 32 DC AF             ld (dead_down),a
 466+ C35A 22 C3 AF     .set:   ld (cam_y),hl
 467+ C35D C9                   ret
 468+ C35E 21 DE AF     .down:  ld hl,dead_wait                 ; on the ground: the pause, then
 469+ C361 35                   dec (hl)                        ; GAME OVER
 470+ C362 C0                   ret nz
 471+ C363 3E 01                ld a,1
 472+ C365 32 E1 AF             ld (game_over),a
 473+ C368 C9                   ret
 474+ C369
 475+ C369              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 476+ C369              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 477+ C369              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 478+ C369              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 479+ C369              pitch_damp:
 480+ C369 2A C7 AF             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 481+ C36C 7C                   ld a,h
 482+ C36D B5                   or l
 483+ C36E C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 484+ C36F 7C                   ld a,h
 485+ C370 F5                   push af                         ; sign
 486+ C371 CD 7F AF             call abs_hl
 487+ C374 54                   ld d,h                          ; whole part of |pitch|
 488+ C375 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 489+ C377 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step
 490+ C379 7A                   ld a,d
 491+ C37A B7                   or a
 492+ C37B 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 493+ C37D 7B                   ld a,e
 494+ C37E FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 495+ C380 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 496+ C382 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN
 497+ C385 B7           .sub:   or a
 498+ C386 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 499+ C388 30 03                jr nc,.sgn
 500+ C38A 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; would pass level: stop at 0
 501+ C38D F1           .sgn:   pop af
 502+ C38E 17                   rla                             ; carry = was nose down
 503+ C38F DC 78 AF             call c,neg_hl
 504+ C392 22 C7 AF             ld (pitch_frac),hl
 505+ C395 C9                   ret

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Autocannon (WPN_AUTOCANNON, a wing pylon, AUTOCANNON_SHOTS shells): the
  41+ C000              ; machine gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_AUTOCANNON, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; AUTOCANNON_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: AUTOCANNON_DMG
  43+ C000              ; within AUTOCANNON_R (3 m) on each axis, AUTOCANNON_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the
  46+ C000              ; autocannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.  Guided: one fires only with a target locked
  54+ C000              ; (lock_update: the reticule), and turns towards it (msl_steer) at
  55+ C000              ; MISSILE_TURN a frame until it is more than LOCK_RANGE away.
  56+ C000              ;
  57+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  58+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  59+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  60+ C000              ;
  61+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  62+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  63+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  64+ C000              ;==============================================================================

 339+ C240              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 340+ C240              ; Aim assist, for a centre slot round IX just spawned, pointing where the gun
 341+ C240              ; does (or a linked chain gun's, from its own muzzle: each on its own): the

 344+ C240              ; AIM_DEV steps of the path, or its box on the path already.  The round turns to its middle, at most
 345+ C240              ; AIM_DEV steps sideways and AIM_DEV up or down: aa_d and aa_ds, kept for the
 346+ C240              ; frame's shots (aim_apply) and the sight.  Only the round: the view doesn't
 347+ C240              ; move.  A chain gun's spread goes on top.

 705+ C524              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 706+ C524              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the
 707+ C524              ; reticule is shown (ret_on).  Searching (lock_state 0), it wanders the view.
 708+ C524              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 709+ C524              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 710+ C524              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a
 711+ C524              ; frame, and after LOCK_TIME frames on it (within LOCK_NEAR) the target is
 712+ C524              ; locked (2): the lock tone, and the reticule stays on it.  The target lost
 713+ C524              ; (killed, out of view, out of range) it searches again.  Then the drawn
 714+ C524              ; marks are cleared for this frame's drawing.

 716+ C524              lock_update:

1540+ CB11              ; A lich's fireballs, every frame (not with the VTOL a wreck).  A lich with

2076+ CF04              ; Pulse laser: SPACE held with the laser in the centre slot fires a beam for

3009+ D6D0 19                   add hl,de

3020+ D6E8 BC                   cp h

3024+ D6EE 18 89                jr .bj

3027+ D6F0              ; (its camera point)

3030+ D6F3 B7                   or a
3031+ D6F4 C0                   ret nz                          ; (a wreck already)

3046+ D71C
3047+ D71C              ; Carry set if |HL - DE| <= rb_r (signed)
3048+ D71C              rb_near:
3049+ D71C B7                   or a
3050+ D71D ED 52                sbc hl,de
3051+ D71F CD 7F AF             call abs_hl
3052+ D722 ED 5B 7D D8          ld de,(rb_r)
3053+ D726 13                   inc de
3054+ D727 B7                   or a
3055+ D728 ED 52                sbc hl,de
3056+ D72A C9                   ret
3057+ D72B
3058+ D72B              ; HL = s -> HL = height of the path there, y0 + s * slope, the drop (or
3059+ D72B              ; climb) rounded to the nearest unit: truncated, a slow round's (a bomb's,
3060+ D72B              ; 20 units a frame) lost up to 1 unit a frame, flattening its glide.  s is
3061+ D72B              ; within one frame's path (under 32768).
3062+ D72B              b_y_at:
3063+ D72B ED 5B 31 D8          ld de,(b_slope)
3064+ D72F CB 7A                bit 7,d
3065+ D731 28 0F                jr z,.up
3066+ D733 E5                   push hl                         ; descending: DE = |slope|
3067+ D734 EB                   ex de,hl
3068+ D735 CD 78 AF             call neg_hl
3069+ D738 EB                   ex de,hl
3070+ D739 E1                   pop hl
3071+ D73A CD 4B D7             call .mag
3072+ D73D CD 78 AF             call neg_hl
3073+ D740 18 03                jr .add
3074+ D742 CD 4B D7     .up:    call .mag
3075+ D745 ED 5B 29 D8  .add:   ld de,(b_y0)
3076+ D749 19                   add hl,de
3077+ D74A C9                   ret
3078+ D74B 29           .mag:   add hl,hl                       ; round(s * DE / 256), both >= 0:
3079+ D74C CD 84 AF             call fmul                       ;   (floor(2 s DE / 256) + 1) / 2
3080+ D74F 23                   inc hl
3081+ D750 CB 3C                srl h
3082+ D752 CB 1D                rr l
3083+ D754 C9                   ret
3084+ D755
3085+ D755              ; HL = s: move round IX to that point of this frame's path
3086+ D755              b_move:
3087+ D755 E5                   push hl
3088+ D756 ED 5B 2D D8          ld de,(b_sin)
3089+ D75A CD 84 AF             call fmul
3090+ D75D ED 5B 27 D8          ld de,(b_x0)
3091+ D761 19                   add hl,de
3092+ D762 DD 75 01             ld (ix+B_X),l
3093+ D765 DD 74 02             ld (ix+B_X+1),h
3094+ D768 E1                   pop hl
3095+ D769 E5                   push hl
3096+ D76A ED 5B 2F D8          ld de,(b_cos)
3097+ D76E CD 84 AF             call fmul
3098+ D771 ED 5B 2B D8          ld de,(b_z0)
3099+ D775 19                   add hl,de
3100+ D776 DD 75 05             ld (ix+B_Z),l
3101+ D779 DD 74 06             ld (ix+B_Z+1),h
3102+ D77C E1                   pop hl
3103+ D77D CD 2B D7             call b_y_at
3104+ D780 DD 75 03             ld (ix+B_Y),l
3105+ D783 DD 74 04             ld (ix+B_Y+1),h
3106+ D786 C9                   ret
3107+ D787
3108+ D787              ; HL = min / max (HL, DE), unsigned
3109+ D787              min_u:
3110+ D787 B7                   or a
3111+ D788 ED 52                sbc hl,de
3112+ D78A 19                   add hl,de
3113+ D78B D8                   ret c
3114+ D78C EB                   ex de,hl
3115+ D78D C9                   ret
3116+ D78E              max_u:
3117+ D78E B7                   or a
3118+ D78F ED 52                sbc hl,de
3119+ D791 19                   add hl,de
3120+ D792 D0                   ret nc
3121+ D793 EB                   ex de,hl
3122+ D794 C9                   ret
3123+ D795
3124+ D795              ; HL = HL + DE, saturating at $FFFF
3125+ D795              add_sat:
3126+ D795 19                   add hl,de
3127+ D796 D0                   ret nc
3128+ D797 21 FF FF             ld hl,$FFFF
3129+ D79A C9                   ret
3130+ D79B
3131+ D79B              ; A:HL / DE -> HL, unsigned, saturating at $FFFF.  DE < $8000.
3132+ D79B              udiv24:
3133+ D79B 47                   ld b,a
3134+ D79C 7A                   ld a,d                          ; quotient over $FFFF?
3135+ D79D B7                   or a
3136+ D79E 20 08                jr nz,.go
3137+ D7A0 78                   ld a,b
3138+ D7A1 BB                   cp e
3139+ D7A2 38 04                jr c,.go
3140+ D7A4 21 FF FF             ld hl,$FFFF
3141+ D7A7 C9                   ret
3142+ D7A8 78           .go:    ld a,b                          ; A:H:L, shifted left 24 times;
3143+ D7A9 0E 18                ld c,24                         ; quotient bits come in at the bottom
3144+ D7AB DD E5                push ix
3145+ D7AD DD 21 00 00          ld ix,0                         ; remainder
3146+ D7B1 29           .lp:    add hl,hl
3147+ D7B2 17                   rla
3148+ D7B3 F5                   push af
3149+ D7B4 DD 29                add ix,ix
3150+ D7B6 F1                   pop af
3151+ D7B7 30 02                jr nc,.n0
3152+ D7B9 DD 23                inc ix
3153+ D7BB E5           .n0:    push hl
3154+ D7BC DD E5                push ix

3156+ D7BF B7                   or a

   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up, after game over, a load error, and quitting from the
   5+ C000              ; pause (menu_go, zpolice.asm, pages it in).  Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256
   6+ C000              ; (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in slot 2) in the large font
   7+ C000              ; (26 x 25 characters), over a picture: ZPDATA/MAINMENU.ZPI, read from the
   8+ C000              ; SD card as the menu opens (l320_image; tools/screen_editor.py edits it),
   9+ C000              ; drawn first as the background, the text printed over it with no paper.  Every frame it
  10+ C000              ; advances the random number generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start
  11+ C000              ; from the same seed each time (the wait for a key press varies), then reads
  12+ C000              ; the keys:
  13+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
  14+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  15+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  16+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  17+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  18+ C000              ; The game start puts the game's Layer 2 back (l2_game_mode).
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              MM_COL          equ 2               ; the options' column
  22+ C000              MM_NOSAVE_ROW   equ 18
  23+ C000
  24+ C000              main_menu:
  25+ C000 CD CC A0             call screen320                  ; (text.asm) the input page in slot 7
  26+ C003 21 A6 C0             ld hl,mm_img                    ; the background picture (none
  27+ C006 CD CF 43             call l320_image                 ; without the file: the plain screen)
  28+ C009 3E E3                ld a,L320_NOPAPER               ; the text over it
  29+ C00B 32 D5 56             ld (l320_paper),a
  30+ C00E 21 4E C0             ld hl,mm_text                   ; title and options
  31+ C011 CD DC 41             call l320_print_list
  32+ C014 CD 57 A1     .loop:  call menu_frame                 ; one video frame
  33+ C017 CD FB 26             call zrand                      ; stir the random number generator
  34+ C01A CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan
  35+ C01D 21 01 03             ld hl,KB_1
  36+ C020 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  37+ C023 C2 81 A8             jp nz,newGame
  38+ C026 21 02 04             ld hl,KB_9                      ; redefine keys
  39+ C029 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  40+ C02C C2 5E AB             jp nz,keydef_go                 ; (zpolice.asm)
  41+ C02F 21 02 03             ld hl,KB_2                      ; continue the save game
  42+ C032 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  43+ C035 28 DD                jr z,.loop
  44+ C037 CD C6 AC             call load_save                  ; (zpolice.asm; pages the file
  45+ C03A D2 02 AD             jp nc,continue_game             ; handler in)
  46+ C03D ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; none (or not usable): say so
  47+ C041 11 06 12             ld de,MM_NOSAVE_ROW<<8 | (F12_COLS-13)/2
  48+ C044 0E E0                ld c,SCR_BAD
  49+ C046 21 98 C0             ld hl,txt_no_save
  50+ C049 CD D0 41             call l320_print_at
  51+ C04C 18 C6                jr .loop
  52+ C04E
  53+ C04E              ; row, column, colour, text, 0 ... $FF
  54+ C04E              mm_text:
  55+ C04E 03 09 FC             db 3, (F12_COLS-8)/2, SCR_TITLE
  56+ C051 5A 2D 50 4F          db "Z-POLICE", 0
  56+ C055 4C 49 43 45
  56+ C059 00
  57+ C05A 09 02 FF             db 9, MM_COL, SCR_TEXT
  58+ C05D 31 2E 20 4E          db "1. NEW GAME", 0
  58+ C061 45 57 20 47
  58+ C065 41 4D 45 00
  59+ C069 0B 02 FF             db 11, MM_COL, SCR_TEXT
  60+ C06C 32 2E 20 43          db "2. CONTINUE SAVED GAME", 0
  60+ C070 4F 4E 54 49
  60+ C074 4E 55 45 20
  60+ C078 53 41 56 45
  60+ C07C 44 20 47 41
  60+ C080 4D 45 00
  61+ C083 0D 02 FF             db 13, MM_COL, SCR_TEXT
  62+ C086 39 2E 20 52          db "9. REDEFINE KEYS", 0
  62+ C08A 45 44 45 46
  62+ C08E 49 4E 45 20
  62+ C092 4B 45 59 53
  62+ C096 00
  63+ C097 FF                   db $FF
  64+ C098              txt_no_save:
  65+ C098 4E 4F 20 53          db "NO SAVED GAME", 0
  65+ C09C 41 56 45 44
  65+ C0A0 20 47 41 4D
  65+ C0A4 45 00
  66+ C0A6 5A 50 44 41  mm_img:     db "ZPDATA/MAINMENU.ZPI", 0 ; (tools/screen_editor.py)
  66+ C0AA 54 41 2F 4D
  66+ C0AE 41 49 4E 4D
  66+ C0B2 45 4E 55 2E

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level complete screen (8K page PAGE_LEVELEND, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; The level's last wave wiped out (main_loop pages it in): LEVEL n COMPLETE,
   6+ C000              ; the weapons rearmed, those aboard rescued, the humans saved and the
   7+ C000              ; salvage, and a line for each reward the salvage gives; then PRESS SPACE TO
   8+ C000              ; CONTINUE and the load-out screen (loadout_go).  After the last level, the
   9+ C000              ; game complete screen instead (game_done_go: menu.asm).  Drawn on Layer 2
  10+ C000              ; at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in slot 2) in the
  11+ C000              ; large font (26 x 25 characters), with the input page in slot 7.
  12+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  13+ C000
  14+ C000              LE_TITLE_ROW    equ 2
  15+ C000              LE_SAVED_ROW    equ 5               ; HUMANS SAVED n
  16+ C000              LE_SALV_ROW     equ 6               ; SALVAGE n
  17+ C000              LE_REARM_ROW    equ 8               ; AMMUNITION REPLENISHED
  18+ C000              LE_COL          equ 1               ; the lines' column (NIGHT VISION -
  19+ C000                                                  ; MONOCHROME is 25 long)
  20+ C000              LE_NUM_COL      equ 17              ; the numbers'
  21+ C000              LE_PROMPT_ROW   equ 23              ; PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE
  22+ C000
  23+ C000              ; The level's last wave is wiped out: LEVEL n COMPLETE, until SPACE is
  24+ C000              ; pressed, then the load-out screen and the next level (next_level,
  25+ C000              ; zpolice.asm)
  26+ C000              level_complete_screen:
  27+ C000 31 F6 B7             ld sp,stack_top
  28+ C003 3A D7 AF             ld a,(level)                    ; the last level: the whole game
  29+ C006 FE 32                cp LEVEL_LAST
  30+ C008 D2 57 AB             jp nc,game_done_go              ; (zpolice.asm: menu.asm's page)
  31+ C00B CD CC A0             call screen320                  ; (text.asm) the input page in slot 7
  32+ C00E 3A D7 AF             ld a,(level)                    ; LEVEL n COMPLETE: its digits (a
  33+ C011 06 2F                ld b,'0'-1                      ; level below LEVEL_LAST: 1 or 2)
  34+ C013 04           .tens:  inc b
  35+ C014 D6 0A                sub 10
  36+ C016 30 FB                jr nc,.tens
  37+ C018 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  38+ C01A 4F                   ld c,a
  39+ C01B 21 58 C0             ld hl,txt_ld_num
  40+ C01E 1E 05                ld e,(F12_COLS-16)/2            ; (centred)
  41+ C020 78                   ld a,b
  42+ C021 FE 30                cp '0'
  43+ C023 28 03                jr z,.units
  44+ C025 77                   ld (hl),a
  45+ C026 23                   inc hl
  46+ C027 1D                   dec e
  47+ C028 71           .units: ld (hl),c
  48+ C029 23                   inc hl
  49+ C02A D5                   push de
  50+ C02B EB                   ex de,hl
  51+ C02C 21 64 C0             ld hl,txt_ld_end
  52+ C02F 01 0A 00             ld bc,TXT_LD_END
  53+ C032 ED B0                ldir
  54+ C034 D1                   pop de
  55+ C035 16 02                ld d,LE_TITLE_ROW
  56+ C037 0E FC                ld c,SCR_TITLE
  57+ C039 21 52 C0             ld hl,txt_level_done
  58+ C03C CD D0 41             call l320_print_at
  59+ C03F CD 6E C0             call rearm_all                  ; every weapon's ammo full again
  60+ C042 CD 3A 32             call hum_unload_all             ; (human.asm) those aboard: rescued
  61+ C045 CD 90 C0             call salvage_award              ; the humans saved: salvage, unlocks
  62+ C048 CD F5 C3             call le_space
  63+ C04B 21 D7 AF             ld hl,level
  64+ C04E 34                   inc (hl)
  65+ C04F C3 50 AB             jp loadout_go                   ; (zpolice.asm) the load-out screen,
  66+ C052                                                      ; then the next level
  67+ C052
  68+ C052              txt_level_done:
  69+ C052 4C 45 56 45          db "LEVEL "
  69+ C056 4C 20
  70+ C058              txt_ld_num:
  71+ C058 00 00 00...          ds 2+TXT_LD_END                 ; (filled in)
  72+ C064              txt_ld_end:
  73+ C064 20 43 4F 4D          db " COMPLETE", 0
  73+ C068 50 4C 45 54
  73+ C06C 45 00
  74+ C06E              TXT_LD_END      equ $-txt_ld_end
  75+ C06E
  76+ C06E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  77+ C06E              ; End of a level: every slot's weapon gets its full load again (wpn_cfg,
  78+ C06E              ; WCFG_LOAD; AMMO_INF for the guns, 0 for an empty slot), and the screen
  79+ C06E              ; says so
  80+ C06E              rearm_all:
  81+ C06E DD 21 CA AF          ld ix,wpn_slots
  82+ C072 06 05                ld b,WPN_SLOTS
